nodes.summary: Real-process acceptance tests of concorde.harness.check_executor.execute_check on an enforcement-capable Linux host. Project mutations must fail at the system call, including through children, aliases, nested user namespaces and TMPDIR tricks; private scratch writes succeed and are cleaned; exit codes and streams are preserved; missing or unsupported sandbox backends never launch the command; and timeouts kill detached descendants. Verifies scenario.harness.check-read-only, check-scratch, check-result, check-unavailable and check-lifetime; bound by module.harness under its Capability and Harness model entity.
nodes.languageNotes: These tests intentionally fail instead of skipping when Linux sandbox enforcement is unavailable, so a missing enforcement backend cannot silently pass.

nodes.name: test_external_references.py
nodes.summary: Tests Module external references: every phase sees the declared entries and a byte change stales them, reading modes are granted only the declared references, and candidate worktrees receive the primary reference checkouts. It reuses ModuleImplementationTests fixtures. Bound by module.harness (Capability and Harness model) and verifies harness scenarios.

nodes.name: test_flows.py
nodes.summary: Tests Harness host flows built on LangGraph: inspection never resolves a context or runs an agent, nested updates and checkpoints hold JSON rather than host objects, concurrent runs keep separate runtime contexts, discovery can exceed the default recursion limit, large batches stop before dependent items, and batch inspection matches executed nodes. It reuses StudioTests fixtures. Bound by module.development and module.harness.

nodes.name: test_model_selection.py
nodes.summary: Tests per-worker and per-child resolution of Pi model, thinking level and timeout in concorde.harness.model_selection (a child entry beats a worker entry, which beats the project default). It also tests admission through concorde.development.configuration, which rejects unknown workers, undeclared children, child timeouts, non-positive timeouts, provider-less models and forged proposals. Verifies scenario.harness.worker-selection and worker-selection-reject; bound by module.harness under Capability and Harness model. Observation: its fixture config declares profile_version 13, while the Framework execution profile names profile_version 14.

nodes.name: test_permissions.py
nodes.summary: Tests concorde.harness.permissions.compile_policy and verify_effective_subset: compiled policies are frozen, canonically ordered, digest-stable and deny-by-default; bindings may narrow but never widen read, write or network effects; and unsafe paths or widened effective policies are rejected. Verifies scenario.harness.permission-compile and permission-reject; bound by module.harness as Permissions. Observation: its fixtures still use Feature-era role names and specs/*/features/ paths, although Protocol 9 defines only Module Specs.

nodes.name: test_pi_worker.py
nodes.summary: Tests the Pi worker stack. The RPC client (concorde.harness.pi_rpc) runs against a fake Pi script. When a real pi executable is installed, PiWorkerRuntime launches run against the scripted FakeOpenAIProvider to prove read/write grant gating, credential stripping for shell commands, one-level child delegation, host-answered run_checks, issue reports that persist even after failures, and distinct missing-submission and deadline failures. Verifies scenario.harness.pi-rpc-client, pi-worker-launch, pi-worker-gate, pi-worker-delegation and scenario.issues.report-independent, report-authority and report-survives-failure; bound by module.harness (Pi worker runtime) and module.issues (Issue store). Observation: module.issues binds it through the entity ID entity.reflections.issue-store, which keeps a legacy 'reflections' prefix.
nodes.languageNotes: PiWorkerTests is gated with unittest.skipUnless on a discovered pi executable, while the RPC client tests always run against a Python fake.

nodes.name: test_scoped_protocol.py
nodes.summary: Extensive scoped-Protocol acceptance suite centred on concorde-main: dependency and document membership validation, direct answers from complete injected contexts, topology design/accept/apply atomicity, canonical-owner authoring with consumer review, digest-bound global discovery contexts with deduplication, snapshot invalidation, parent cycles and symlinks, gap recording, and real checks gating readiness and delivery. Bound by seven Modules (Framework acceptance tests, dev-loop, development worktree lifecycle, harness Context resolution, query-routing, topology and validation adapters). Observation: it declares harness, development and concorde scenarios but none owned by module.query-routing, module.topology, module.validation or module.dev-loop.

nodes.name: test_session_handoff.py
nodes.summary: Unittest suite for handoff_prompt, checking that the default prompt is honest (uses the UNKNOWN placeholder), self-contained, performs no filesystem access into the target worktree, preserves task/constraints/artifact paths verbatim including non-English text, and widens its fence so an embedded ```text block cannot terminate the copyable block. Bound by both module.harness (entity.harness.worktree-lifecycle) and module.development (entity.development.worktree-lifecycle). Observation: the file declares no @verifies scenario IDs, so none of its three tests contributes to scenario coverage for either owning Module.

nodes.name: test_studio.py
nodes.summary: Tests the Studio graph surface of public capabilities: shared input validation, envelope, configuration and workspace enforcement, parity with local JSON execution, streamed agent stages, describe-policy without agents, thread reuse, UTF-8 input limits, authority bypass attempts, failure events, and rejection of internal stages and symlink roots. It also exports the invocation, stable and assert_public_inventory helpers reused by other Studio and review tests. Bound by module.development and module.harness (Studio).

nodes.name: test_studio_client.py
nodes.summary: Tests the Studio client that forwards capability runs to a local LangGraph server: remote and redirect URLs are rejected, a lost connection after submission never retries or runs locally, polling preserves the server result, failed or interrupted runs report the thread without reading stale state, and incompatible results are refused. Bound by module.harness (Studio).

nodes.name: test_studio_server.py
nodes.summary: Opt-in tests (CONCORDE_TEST_STUDIO=1) that start a real `langgraph dev` server over temporary fixtures and check registered assistants and schemas, flow topology through the viewer API, parity between direct execution and the run-capability launcher, live streams, workspace blocking, loop checkpoints inside the fixture worktree and executor-failure forwarding. Bound by module.development, module.harness (Studio) and module.specify-loop. Observation: the module docstring calls these 'WorkerProfile Server checks' although they exercise the Studio server, and none of its scenario declarations belong to module.specify-loop.

nodes.name: test_usage.py
nodes.summary: Unittest suite for the harness usage ledger: each worker launch appends exactly one labelled JSON line under the root run directory, summarize_usage totals per step/stage/target/worker, and a persistence failure (an unwritable .concorde path) never fails the launch. Bound by module.harness as entity.harness.agent-model; all three tests declare scenario.harness.usage-accounting.

nodes.name: test_worker_binding.py
nodes.summary: Tests that every launch binds a worker definition and derives effective authority from it: narrowed implementation writes are never widened, the issue solver is spec-only, describe-policy exposes the bound worker and model selection, Pi workers receive the profile timeout and their configured model, and cancelled or limit-exhausted outcomes stay distinguishable on the wire and in change status. Bound by module.harness (Capability and Harness model) and module.implementation (Implementation adapter).

nodes.name: test_worker_executor.py
nodes.summary: Tests the worker executor with a real CapabilityHost and only the Pi process substituted: the launch carries the profile grant, children and result contract; preflight refuses forged bindings, instructions, policies and identities; runtime failures map to distinct outcomes without retry; out-of-contract results are invalid completions; and Protocol files are appended to instructions in order. Bound by module.harness (Worker execution).

nodes.name: test_worker_profile.py
nodes.summary: Tests worker profiles and build-bound bindings: resolve_worker succeeds for every inventory worker against a freshly built package, loaded bindings and effects match, a changed child definition stales the build, unknown workers fail closed, and profiles cannot exceed their contract or workspace. Bound by module.harness (Capability and Harness model); it also exercises concorde.distribution.build.

nodes.name: test_worktree_boundary.py
nodes.summary: Tests the boundary checks in concorde.harness.worktree on real git repositories: the primary worktree requires an explicit override, a linked worktree is isolated and sees only the committed base, and a non-git directory has no mutation boundary unless explicitly allowed. Verifies scenario.harness.worktree-boundary; bound by module.development and module.harness as Worktree lifecycle.

nodes.name: test_worktree_lifecycle.py
nodes.summary: Large lifecycle suite for candidate worktrees and delivery: primary-mutation handoffs, bound and unbound resume, owner binding, partial Spec reconciliation, pending-file confirmation at delivery, independent branch staging, primary merge preview, recovery and conflicts, retention and cleanup retries, and integration checks after primary advances. Bound by eight Modules (Framework acceptance tests, delivery, dev-loop, development and harness worktree lifecycle, query-routing, specify-loop and validation adapters). Observation: its @verifies declarations name development, harness and concorde scenarios but none owned by module.delivery, module.validation, module.specify-loop, module.query-routing or module.dev-loop.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the Issues test package. Bound by module.issues under its Issue store entity.

nodes.name: test_archive.py

nodes.name: test_disposition_recovery.py
nodes.summary: Crash and race recovery tests for Issue dispositions during solving: journal persistence failure cannot publish a close, oversized dispositions are rejected before journaling, interruptions leave an exact durable journal, lost acknowledgements and checkpoints recover idempotently, concurrent reopen and edits are preserved, and corrupted or legacy journals fail closed. It reuses IssueFlowTests fixtures. Bound by module.issues (Issue store).

nodes.name: test_flow.py

nodes.name: test_reporting.py
nodes.summary: Tests the IssueReporter boundary and its host integration: unknown owners are recorded honestly while foreign owners, paths and forged provenance are refused, reporters cannot append to ungranted issues, multiple reports do not fail a completed stage, queries report without project write authority, failed completions keep accepted reports, and previews never create issues. Bound by module.issues (Issue store).

nodes.name: test_scope.py
nodes.summary: Small tests that component Issue contexts stay separate during a development loop: a foreign component is not a write grant and a component blocker keeps the reporting owner. Bound by module.issues (Issue store). Observation: it declares no @verifies scenario IDs, so it contributes no scenario coverage.

nodes.name: test_store.py
nodes.summary: Tests the durable Issue store: versioned idempotent reports without a change, no semantic deduplication, appends bound to current bytes with reclassification, parallel reports, disposition evidence, duplicate checks inside the transaction, rejection of invalid reports and symlinks, failed publishes, and independent dispositions on branch copies. It exports the report/source builders reused by other Issue tests. Bound by module.issues (Issue store).

Bound by module.spec (entity.spec.spec-model) and module.spec-authoring (entity.spec-authoring.adapter). Observation: none of its twenty-nine test methods declares a @verifies scenario ID.

Bound by module.spec (Spec model). Observation: it largely exercises Distribution code (package validation, build, installer) although module.distribution does not bind it.

Bound by module.spec (Spec model) and module.concorde (Framework acceptance tests).

nodes.summary: Extensive tests of the Module implementation model: scenario focus, profile-14 Protocol binding, file names versus contents by phase, shared files and the reverse index, directory entries with exclusions and longest-prefix ownership, pending files confirmed at delivery, registry/entity listing equality, composition cycles, writer and review identity invalidation, external references and code-writer limits. Bound by module.spec (Spec model); its ModuleImplementationTests fixture is reused by the external-reference tests.

nodes.name: test_protocol_v5.py

nodes.name: test_requirements_and_verification.py

Bound by module.spec as entity.spec.spec-model; declares scenario.spec.reader-parts, scenario.spec.reference-invalid and scenario.spec.reference-resolution.

nodes.name: test_typed_data.py

Task-control values validate without side effects or input rewriting (filesystem and lifecycle calls are guarded); artifact references detect changed, missing or symlinked files; JSON decoding rejects duplicate keys and non-finite numbers; and configuration migration preserves unrelated fields while rejecting stale proposals. Verifies scenario.spec.task-control-values and scenario.harness.typed-reject; bound by module.harness and module.spec as Typed values.
nodes.languageNotes: Side-effect freedom is enforced by patching os/io/builtins file primitives with AssertionError side effects inside an ExitStack while validation runs.

Verifies scenario.views.scaffold-propose, scaffold-apply and scaffold-stale-rejected; bound by module.views as Publication scaffold.

nodes.name: test_docsite_template.py
nodes.summary: Tests the inventory functions of concorde.views.docsite_template on a fake package and on the real repository: the exact template file rule, adapter files that exclude scaffold-only directories, workflow template bytes, deterministic content digests, symlink rejection and package-root verification. Bound by module.views as entity.views.publication-scaffold; declares scenario.views.scaffold-stale-rejected and scenario.views.scaffold-apply. nodes.name: Concorde Framework
nodes.summary: Concorde helps developers agree on what software should do, carry out changes within explicit boundaries, and check the result before delivery. Its specifications explain responsibilities and design as well as precise behavior. Developers can also ask questions, inspect documentation and track problems without starting a code change. Registry: parent none (root Module); uses 0 Module(s); binds 8 implementation file(s); owns 7 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Delivery
nodes.summary: Delivery publishes a verified candidate as an independent branch and normally removes its source worktree. Updating the primary branch is a separate, explicitly authorized step. Developers use this boundary to distinguish a checked proposal from an accepted primary-branch change. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 4 Module(s); binds 2 implementation file(s); owns 4 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Development Flow
nodes.summary: Development Flow takes one intended change through specification, planning, implementation and verification. It coordinates the contributing Modules and preserves progress when work stops. Success is a ready candidate; delivery and primary merging are separate choices. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 9 Module(s); binds 6 implementation file(s); owns 4 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Development
nodes.summary: Development is the common host through which Concorde operations are requested and run. It checks requests, selects the allowed operation and workspace, and records accepted results. Individual providers decide what their operation means; workflows decide how those operations form a larger task. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 14 Module(s); binds 58 implementation file(s); owns 9 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Distribution
nodes.summary: Distribution prepares the Framework assets that developers install and run: instructions, Skills and managed runtime dependencies. It builds from authored sources and installs only the outputs it owns. It does not decide or silently rewrite a consumer project’s business specification. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 1 Module(s); binds 90 implementation file(s); owns 7 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Harness
nodes.summary: The Harness Module prepares and runs a worker with a defined task, information and permissions, then checks the result. It also runs configured checks in a separate read-only environment. Other Modules rely on it to execute work without treating an agent answer as permission for unrelated actions. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 2 Module(s); binds 120 implementation file(s); owns 13 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Implementation
nodes.summary: Implementation fulfills accepted tasks by changing the code that its worker is allowed to access. It reports which tasks are complete without weakening their acceptance conditions. Independent checks, review, readiness and delivery remain separate decisions. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 3 Module(s); binds 3 implementation file(s); owns 4 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Issues
nodes.summary: Issues keeps a durable record of observed problems and supports their explicit investigation, repair and verification. Recording a problem does not itself stop work or authorize code changes. Developers use it when a concern must remain visible beyond the current conversation. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 6 Module(s); binds 19 implementation file(s); owns 7 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Planning
nodes.summary: Planning checks whether a task is sufficiently specified, produces a plan and turns an accepted plan into implementation tasks. It helps a workflow decide what should be done before code work starts. It neither implements the plan nor declares the whole change ready. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 3 Module(s); binds 4 implementation file(s); owns 7 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Query and Routing
nodes.summary: Query and Routing answers questions from selected specifications and identifies the Module responsible for an intended task. It preserves the developer’s request rather than rewriting the goal to fit available code. Missing knowledge leads to explicit selection or a reported gap, not unrestricted searching. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 3 Module(s); binds 4 implementation file(s); owns 4 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Review
nodes.summary: Review independently examines whether current specifications or code support the requested task. It returns findings and the scope actually examined, without repairing files. A successful review is evidence about those inputs and that question, not proof that every possible problem is absent. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 4 Module(s); binds 5 implementation file(s); owns 5 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Spec
nodes.summary: The Spec Module records which documents belong to each Module, determines which specifications a task may read, and checks that their structure and references agree. It also creates an initial project specification without inventing business behavior. Developers and the Framework use it to establish the intended contract before work begins. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 0 Module(s); binds 52 implementation file(s); owns 8 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Spec Authoring
nodes.summary: Spec Authoring proposes changes to a Module’s intended behavior and design. It works from the allowed specifications and explicit intent, not from source code used to guess missing requirements. The host checks and applies owned proposals; independent review belongs to the calling workflow. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 3 Module(s); binds 6 implementation file(s); owns 4 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Specification Flow
nodes.summary: Specification Flow prepares or revises a Module’s specification and obtains independent review before any coding is required. It lets developers settle intended behavior first. Successful completion produces accepted Spec-stage work, not an implementation or a ready development candidate. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 6 Module(s); binds 4 implementation file(s); owns 4 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Topology
nodes.summary: Topology changes the declared responsibility structure of a project: Module ownership, composition, references and file bindings. It prepares consistent changes for review before applying them together. Developers use it when boundaries must change, not just when editing the behavior of one existing Module. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 4 Module(s); binds 2 implementation file(s); owns 4 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Validation
nodes.summary: Validation checks specification structure and runs configured verification commands against the current candidate. It uses those results and existing completion requirements to assess readiness. It does not repair failures or deliver the change. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 3 Module(s); binds 5 implementation file(s); owns 4 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: Views
nodes.summary: Views publishes registered specifications as a readable website and provides tools to export, analyze or open code-structure graphs. Developers use it to understand a project and inspect its declared relationships. A published page or graph does not by itself prove that the code satisfies the specification. Registry: parent module.concorde; uses 3 Module(s); binds 74 implementation file(s); owns 9 Spec document unit(s).

nodes.name: FlowSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one bound Flow diagram: its document path, bound Flow name, parsed nodes and labeled edges.

nodes.name: flow_specs
nodes.summary: Collects every Mermaid fence bound with `%% flow:` from registered Spec documents and parses it into FlowSpec records in path order.

nodes.name: compare
nodes.summary: Lists disagreements between a FlowSpec and a compiled topology: node and edge sets, duplicate edges, missing or superfluous routing labels, and node labels lacking `in:`/`out:` state.

nodes.name: _imports_functional_api
nodes.summary: AST predicate reporting whether an import statement names LangGraph's Functional API (`langgraph.func` or `from langgraph import func`).

nodes.name: functional_api_imports
nodes.summary: Parses every Python file below src, scripts and capabilities (skipping excluded and dot directories) and reports Functional API imports or unparsable files as hits.

nodes.name: flow_spec_findings
nodes.summary: Produces CONCORDE-FLOW findings: non-StateGraph catalog Flows, Functional API imports, diagram parse errors, unknown or duplicate bindings, topology mismatches and catalog Flows without a Flow Spec.

nodes.name: create_parser
nodes.summary: Builds the `concorde` argparse parser with subcommands validate, docsite, ua-graph, ua-analyze, build, protocol-manifest and usage and their options.

nodes.name: dispatch
nodes.summary: Routes parsed arguments to usage summaries, docsite propose/apply, UA graph export, UA analysis, build/check, or repository validation, converting build errors into invalid ToolResults.

nodes.name: _protocol_manifest
nodes.summary: Developer-only protocol-manifest command: verifies build freshness, recomputes Protocol asset digests, optionally writes the tracked manifest and binds `.concorde/config.json` plus the project Protocol copy.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry: parses arguments, enforces an isolated worktree for mutating tools, dispatches, and always writes the canonical JSON envelope (a failed envelope on any exception) returning the status exit code.

nodes.name: protocol_asset_path
nodes.summary: Maps a rendered `generated/protocol/<name>` asset path to its installed `.concorde/protocol/<name>` location, rejecting other prefixes.

nodes.name: protocol_files
nodes.summary: Verifies build freshness and returns the Protocol manifest plus every listed rendered asset whose digest still matches, keyed by installed path.

nodes.name: project_default_files
nodes.summary: Returns the Concorde-owned default ignore files for the Issues and topology-proposal directories.

nodes.name: write_protocol_copy
nodes.summary: Writes the verified Protocol bundle into a project the way the installer does, for source-checkout tooling and fixtures.

nodes.name: install_project_defaults
nodes.summary: Places the Protocol copy and any absent Concorde-owned defaults into a project for fixtures and tooling (not a receipt-owned install).

nodes.name: git
nodes.summary: Runs a Git command against a worktree root with captured text output, raising a workspace_mismatch SpecError on failure when checking is enabled.

nodes.name: list_worktrees
nodes.summary: Parses `git worktree list --porcelain -z` into records with resolved path, branch, head, lock and liveness, skipping bare entries.

nodes.name: workspace_identity
nodes.summary: Returns the primary and current worktree records, requiring that a capability starts at its worktree root.

nodes.name: repository_lock
nodes.summary: Context manager taking an exclusive `fcntl` lock in the Git common directory to serialize registry updates and deliveries across linked worktrees.

nodes.name: _exclude_control_files
nodes.summary: Appends Concorde's local control paths to the shared Git `info/exclude` file so worktree state never enters a delivered tree.

nodes.name: read_change
nodes.summary: Loads and strictly validates `.concorde/worktree.json`: schema, identity fields, owner/task consistency, Issue blocker history against stored reports, branch and primary identity, guidance and graph shapes.

nodes.name: _summary
nodes.summary: Summarizes one linked worktree for the primary inventory, including managed change identity, task excerpt, phase, status and outcome.

nodes.name: _inventory
nodes.summary: Builds the primary worktree's inventory of live linked worktrees and optionally persists it to `.concorde/worktrees.json`.

nodes.name: save_change
nodes.summary: Persists a change state for its own worktree under the repository lock and optionally republishes the primary inventory.

nodes.name: strip_guidance
nodes.summary: Removes the single Concorde change-worktree guidance block from AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md content, rejecting modified or ambiguous markers.

nodes.name: _guidance_changes
nodes.summary: Prepares file changes that append the change-worktree session guidance block to AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md and records whether each file was created.

nodes.name: ensure_change
nodes.summary: Adopts or creates the managed change state for a worktree, refusing primary use unless allowed, legacy attempt state, detached branches and tracked control paths, then writes guidance and state atomically.

nodes.name: replicate_reference_checkouts
nodes.summary: Copies readable files of the primary's vendored submodule checkouts into a new linked worktree without network access, excluding media and dot entries.

nodes.name: create_worktree
nodes.summary: Creates a new `concorde/<uuid>` linked worktree from the primary branch head, replicates reference checkouts, adopts the change and rebuilds generated assets for self-hosted Concorde.

nodes.name: resume_owner
nodes.summary: Restores omitted owner fields on resume and rejects requests that conflict with the persisted task, constraints, focus or target.

nodes.name: bind_owner
nodes.summary: Binds a target Module and task to the change on first use, or checks a later request against the recorded owner.

nodes.name: target_state
nodes.summary: Returns the recorded per-target plan/progress state, or a fresh plan-phase record when creation is allowed.

nodes.name: progress
nodes.summary: Updates the change phase, status, outcome and blockers (keeping open Issue blockers) and optionally invalidates validation evidence.

nodes.name: graph_state
nodes.summary: Creates or returns a target's dev-loop repair-graph record, resetting repair counters with a `human` transition when Spec or implementation digests changed outside an admitted repair.

nodes.name: blocker_scope
nodes.summary: Resolves the durable Module work scope a request belongs to from recorded root, component and review intents rather than hashed task wording.

nodes.name: record_task_gaps
nodes.summary: Records Issue blockers keyed by change, Module, scope, phase and Issue, attaches context evidence, and releases dependencies after fresh successful assessments without closing Issues.

nodes.name: unchanged_task_gaps
nodes.summary: Returns open blockers still valid for the same scope, phase, Spec digest and review input, filtering code-review blockers to contract-repair gaps.

nodes.name: workspace_context
nodes.summary: Builds the workspace context record: kind (primary, change or unversioned), branches, change phase/status, scoped open blockers, component progress and active worktrees.

nodes.name: snapshot_tree
nodes.summary: Captures the exact deliverable Git tree using a temporary index, excluding control paths and stripping injected guidance blocks.

nodes.name: run_in_studio
nodes.summary: Submits an invocation to a localhost Studio server as a thread run with reject multitask strategy, polls until completion and validates the capability result, failing without fallback or retry.

nodes.name: require_delivery_session
nodes.summary: Admits delivery only from the selected change's source worktree or the primary, rejecting third-worktree, nested or unrelated package sessions and detached primaries.

nodes.name: _verify_merged_tree
nodes.summary: Checks a merged commit in a temporary detached worktree: fresh build when self-hosted, Spec validation, every configured check with copied logs, and tree immutability.

nodes.name: _cleanup
nodes.summary: After a successful merge, retains or removes the source worktree, verifying branch, head and candidate tree, and records delivered or cleanup_pending receipt status.

nodes.name: deliver
nodes.summary: Public delivery entry: admits the session, requires the primary session for explicit merges, runs delivery against the primary root and persists blocked or cleanup status on failure.

nodes.name: _remember_failure
nodes.summary: Persists a failed delivery's phase and status on the source change and updates a merged receipt to cleanup_pending.

nodes.name: _deliver
nodes.summary: Core delivery: describe-policy preview, receipt-based resumption, ready-state and tree checks, completion verification, pending-file confirmation, merge commit construction, merged-tree verification, durable receipt then ref updates and cleanup.

nodes.name: _merge_primary
nodes.summary: Promotes an already staged delivery into the primary branch by the primary owner: rechecks receipt and refs, requires a clean primary, verifies the merge and fast-forwards.

nodes.name: _response
nodes.summary: Builds the typed `concorde-deliver-response` describing merge, retention, confirmed and still-pending files and primary-merge state.

nodes.name: archive_reflections
nodes.summary: Renames `.concorde/reflections` to `.concorde/archive/reflections` under the Issue lock, refusing symlinks and existing destinations.

nodes.name: IssueState
nodes.summary: TypedDict channel schema of `issue_flow`: route, output and result.

nodes.name: build_issue_flow
nodes.summary: Compiles the `issue_flow` StateGraph: select_operation routes to inspect, report, reopen or prepare; prepare/decide/develop/repair_spec/verify route by state; close leads to ready.

nodes.name: VerificationState
nodes.summary: TypedDict channel schema of the nested Issue verification loop: index, stop flag and output.

nodes.name: build_issue_verification_flow
nodes.summary: Compiles the `issue_verification_flow` StateGraph that repeats `review_item` until its stop flag is set.

nodes.name: pending_disposition
nodes.summary: Validates a candidate-local write-ahead disposition journal (identity, byte digests, single closing solver disposition) before it may authorize restoration.

nodes.name: prepare_request
nodes.summary: Binds an Issues request before workspace creation: requires explicit Issue IDs, checks revisions and pending journals, forbids cross-Module authority, derives the solve task and selects the target.

nodes.name: copy_selection
nodes.summary: Copies exactly the selected Issue file into a host-created candidate worktree after checking its revision digest.

nodes.name: issue_nodes
nodes.summary: Returns the node implementations of `issue_flow`: inspect/report/reopen actions and bounded solving (prepare, decide via the Issue solver worker, develop, Spec repair, Issue-specific verification, journaled close, final validation with restoration, finish).

nodes.name: receipt
nodes.summary: Projects an Issue reference to its schema-checked receipt fields (issue_id, report_id, path).

nodes.name: observation_context
nodes.summary: Builds the typed `concorde-issue-context` of unique observations with only description, impact and basis text.

nodes.name: validate_references
nodes.summary: Rejects Issue references that were neither admitted nor reported for the worker, or that repeat, and confirms each resolves.

nodes.name: requires_contract_repair
nodes.summary: Reports whether any referenced observation is a missing-contract or spec-conflict gap.

nodes.name: IssueReporter
nodes.summary: Thread-safe per-invocation reporting callable: validates provenance and admitted owners at construction, then checks report owner, evidence paths and selected Issues before persisting and returning receipt and revision.

nodes.name: reporter_for_invocation
nodes.summary: Derives an IssueReporter from an invocation's frozen context: admitted owners, evidence paths, source provenance with Git head, and admitted or selected Issues.

nodes.name: issue_path
nodes.summary: Returns the `.concorde/issues/<id>.md` path after validating the Issue ID pattern.

nodes.name: validate_report
nodes.summary: Validates a report against the REPORT schema, gap-subtype pairing, append field pairing and the 64 KiB size limit.

nodes.name: validate_record
nodes.summary: Validates a whole Issue record: each observation digest, unique observations, identity derived from the first report and a consistent disposition state machine.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses an Issue Markdown file with its identity heading and single JSON fence, validating the record and filename identity.

nodes.name: read_issue
nodes.summary: Reads and parses one Issue file with a size limit, returning the record and its byte digest revision.

nodes.name: list_issues
nodes.summary: Read-only listing of Issue metadata filtered by status and target, never creating the collection.

nodes.name: _lock
nodes.summary: Exclusive `fcntl` lock under `.concorde/runs/issues.lock` serializing report allocation and dispositions.

nodes.name: _publish_text
nodes.summary: Publishes Issue text through the digest-bound file transaction and fsyncs the directory before acknowledging.

nodes.name: report_issue
nodes.summary: Persists a report idempotently per trusted invocation and report key, creating a new Issue or appending to an open one at the expected revision, and returns the receipt.

nodes.name: disposition_record
nodes.summary: Prepares a validated record with one appended disposition without writing or granting authority.

nodes.name: dispose_issue
nodes.summary: Trusted host disposition: checks record and duplicate-target revisions under the lock, publishes the updated record and returns its new digest.

nodes.name: restore_issue
nodes.summary: Idempotently restores an Issue's exact open before-image under the lock, refusing if concurrent edits occurred.

nodes.name: resolve_report
nodes.summary: Resolves an immutable observation by receipt, checking path/identity agreement.

nodes.name: file_change
nodes.summary: Builds a change entry with the file's current before-digest (or null) and new content.

nodes.name: apply_files
nodes.summary: Applies a unique, host-authorized, digest-checked change set with atomic fsynced writes, optional verification and full rollback of written files on any failure.

nodes.name: confirm_pending_files
nodes.summary: Confirms pending entries that now exist by delegating to document-unit pending confirmation on a fresh SpecRepository.

nodes.name: author_candidate
nodes.summary: Validates an owner-only author proposal: complete digest-bound replacements of the Module's own members, stable document identities and a validating overlay repository.

nodes.name: apply_author_changes
nodes.summary: Applies a validated author proposal atomically on disk, rechecking baseline resolution, registry bytes and expected context identities during the transaction.

nodes.name: pending_changes
nodes.summary: Plans metadata-only removal of pending markers whose entries now exist and lists still-missing entries.

nodes.name: confirm_pending_units
nodes.summary: Validates and applies pending-marker removals over an on-disk base with context-identity checks, returning confirmed and missing entries.

nodes.name: legacy_reading_problems
nodes.summary: Checks legacy Protocol reading parts (Usage & Contract, Architecture & Realization) and their required subsections, prose and fences.

nodes.name: PreservedMeaning
nodes.summary: Record of one readable meaning carried over during migration: category, identity, field and text.

nodes.name: DocumentMigration
nodes.summary: Migration plan for one document: the admitted unit and optional implementation unit, before digest, preserved meanings, editorial notes and a report stating the semantic rewrite is not completed.

nodes.name: _blocks
nodes.summary: Returns closed outer fence blocks as source-line slices so example fences never become declarations.

nodes.name: _layout
nodes.summary: Re-lays out a legacy document into the Protocol 9 entry section order while dropping retired metadata fences.

nodes.name: _admit_split
nodes.summary: Splits formal requirements and scenarios into a new implementation-role companion and admits both resulting units with consistent anchors.

nodes.name: plan_document_migration
nodes.summary: Plans one legacy document's conversion to a schema-2 document unit without modifying sources, preserving declarations and reporting remaining editorial work.

nodes.name: preview_registered_migration
nodes.summary: Reads a legacy schema-4 registry and reports per-document conversion previews or errors without writing a candidate.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Read-only developer command printing the registered migration preview as JSON and returning a nonzero status on errors.

nodes.name: ContentModelError
nodes.summary: SpecError subclass for source-local document-unit admission failures, carrying the offending path.

nodes.name: metadata_path
nodes.summary: Returns the exact `.md.json` companion path of a durable Markdown reading source, rejecting control directories.

nodes.name: SourceMember
nodes.summary: Frozen source member of a document unit (path, reading or metadata role, exact bytes) with a digest property.

nodes.name: ReadingMeaning
nodes.summary: Frozen local readable explanation resolved from a reading anchor: anchor, text and line.

nodes.name: DocumentUnit
nodes.summary: Admitted reading/metadata pair with identity and owner, immutable declarations view, sorted sources, byte-bound identity digest and anchor meaning lookup.

nodes.name: reading_meanings
nodes.summary: Resolves explicit heading and standalone anchors outside fences into bounded local explanation sections.

nodes.name: terminology_body
nodes.summary: Returns the prose of the real level-2 Terminology section, ignoring fenced examples.

nodes.name: terminology_problems
nodes.summary: Checks Terminology placement, table header and rows, and that imported terms link directly to a `#terminology` table.

nodes.name: reading_problems
nodes.summary: Checks reading structure: retired metadata fences, canonical contract placement, formal definitions only in implementation-role units, entry section order, Purpose prose and Relationships diagrams.

nodes.name: json_declarations
nodes.summary: Extracts and decodes JSON payloads of fences with a given language outside other fences, rejecting unclosed declarations.

nodes.name: metadata_identity
nodes.summary: Reads document identity, owner and role from metadata alone, validating the closed envelope, schema version, extensions and ownership.

nodes.name: admit_document_unit
nodes.summary: Admits one explicitly supplied reading/metadata pair: UTF-8 and JSON decoding, identity, reading structure, and entity, dependency and participant-binding declarations with local meaning anchors.

nodes.name: load_document_unit
nodes.summary: Reads exactly one selected reading/metadata pair from disk and admits it.

nodes.name: unit_resolution_schema
nodes.summary: Returns the closed schema of a paired-source Spec context resolution (query, Module, reading entry, documents, references, registration and reasoned source records).

nodes.name: DocumentUnitRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol 9 source backend over registry schema 5: byte overlays, identity index without reading bodies, unit admission, source records and validation, one-level spec_context resolution, contracts, definitions, implementation listings, freshness rechecks and whole-repository validation.

nodes.name: task_request
nodes.summary: Returns the shared task-selection request schema, with target_id required or optional depending on whether routing is still needed.

nodes.name: capability_response
nodes.summary: Returns the common capability response schema with outcome, answer, artifacts, blockers, checks and completed capabilities.

nodes.name: envelope
nodes.summary: Builds the schema-2 tool result envelope with sorted unique artifacts and deterministically ordered findings.

nodes.name: tool_envelope
nodes.summary: Converts a ToolResult into the canonical envelope.

nodes.name: canonical_json
nodes.summary: Serializes a value as sorted, compact, newline-terminated JSON.

nodes.name: exit_code
nodes.summary: Maps a result status to its process exit code, defaulting to 3.

nodes.name: protocol_binding
nodes.summary: Computes the package Protocol binding (version and manifest digest) after verifying build freshness.

nodes.name: installed_protocol_binding
nodes.summary: Reads the binding of the installer-placed `.concorde/protocol/` copy, failing with not_installed when absent.

nodes.name: empty_target
nodes.summary: Returns an empty registry Module target with documents but no references, parent, uses, files or checks.

nodes.name: initial_module_metadata
nodes.summary: Returns schema-2 metadata for the initial Module entry declaring Project Spec, Developer and Concorde Framework entities.

nodes.name: initial_module_text
nodes.summary: Renders the honest initial `module.md` with the required sections, explicit unknowns and an authoring-boundary Mermaid diagram.

nodes.name: project_proposal
nodes.summary: Builds the creation-only initialization proposal of configuration, registry and paired Module stub after validating the capability configuration and refusing configured projects.

nodes.name: apply_project_proposal
nodes.summary: Applies an initialization proposal after envelope, binding and creation-only checks, validating the resulting repository before committing the transaction.

nodes.name: Finding
nodes.summary: Frozen diagnostic record: rule ID, severity, source, message, remediation and optional line, column and subject.

nodes.name: ProposalFile
nodes.summary: Frozen compatibility record of a proposed file path, content and SHA-256.

nodes.name: ToolResult
nodes.summary: Frozen tool outcome: tool, target, status, artifacts, findings and result mapping.

nodes.name: SpecRepository
nodes.summary: Installed-Protocol repository: validates project root and `.concorde/config.json` (Profile 14, exact fields), initializes the document-unit backend from the configured registry, admits the Protocol copy and can rebuild a fresh instance with the same overlays.

nodes.name: SpecError
nodes.summary: ValueError subclass carrying a machine error code and field for Spec and host failures.

nodes.name: digest
nodes.summary: Returns the `sha256:` digest of bytes or of a value's canonical JSON.

nodes.name: read_file
nodes.summary: Reads a regular project file with no symlink components using O_NOFOLLOW, raising missing_source otherwise.

nodes.name: identifier
nodes.summary: Validates a stable project identity against the Protocol identity pattern.

nodes.name: check_entry
nodes.summary: Validates a listing entry spelling, returning its base path and rejecting control or generated paths.

nodes.name: expand_entry
nodes.summary: Lists existing regular files bound by an exact or directory entry, skipping excluded directories, dot entries, symlinks and skipped suffixes.

nodes.name: walk_lines
nodes.summary: Classifies each Markdown line as prose, fence-open, fenced or fence-close with 1-based numbers.

nodes.name: SpecTarget
nodes.summary: Frozen registered Module record with documents, parent, uses, files, checks and references, plus paired source and reading-entry properties.

nodes.name: SpecDocument
nodes.summary: Frozen reading view of a registered document: path, content, digest, identity, owner, metadata and body.

nodes.name: SpecResolution
nodes.summary: Immutable serialized context resolution whose decoded value fields are exposed as attributes.

nodes.name: Requirement
nodes.summary: Frozen Module-level requirement: ID, title, single SHALL statement, owner, document and line.

nodes.name: Scenario
nodes.summary: Frozen testable scenario: ID, title, owner, document, line and GIVEN/WHEN/THEN steps.

nodes.name: SpecEntity
nodes.summary: Frozen declared entity with title, kind, responsibility text, file and pending entries, optional provider target, owner and document.

nodes.name: ModuleDefinitions
nodes.summary: All scenarios, requirements and entities a Module's own documents define, with an anchor-to-document map.

nodes.name: RepositoryCore
nodes.summary: Shared repository query mixin: installed Protocol admission, registry loading and validation, Module/scenario selection, context paths and identities, affected contexts, contracts and bindings, definitions, test verifications, external references, implementation listings, reverse file users and affected Modules.

nodes.name: _logical_lines
nodes.summary: Joins walked Markdown lines into logical lines used by definition parsing.

nodes.name: _parse_definitions
nodes.summary: Parses requirement and scenario heading sections of one document, enforcing single-SHALL statements, step keywords and order, and no nested headings.

nodes.name: ContractError
nodes.summary: ValueError subclass carrying a JSON pointer field for schema admission and validation failures.

nodes.name: admit
nodes.summary: Recursively admits a schema in the supported subset, rejecting unknown keywords, types, non-local references and invalid bounds, patterns or formats.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Validates a value against an admitted schema with depth limit, combinators, const/enum, types, object/array/string/number constraints and project-path format.

nodes.name: TypedDataError
nodes.summary: ValueError subclass with a code and field, serializable to a dict for typed-value failures.

nodes.name: canonical
nodes.summary: Serializes a value as sorted compact JSON without NaN constants.

nodes.name: decode
nodes.summary: Decodes JSON rejecting duplicate keys and non-JSON numeric constants.

nodes.name: check_schema
nodes.summary: Standard-library schema checker for typed values: anyOf, local refs, exact types, const/enum, typed-task objects, closed or keyed-map objects, arrays with unique artifacts and string formats.

nodes.name: safe_path
nodes.summary: Accepts only canonical project-relative POSIX paths without control characters, colons, backslashes or dot segments.

nodes.name: checked_path
nodes.summary: Resolves a safe relative path under a project root, rejecting any symlink component.

nodes.name: typed
nodes.summary: Wraps data in a TypedValue envelope with the current type version and validates it.

nodes.name: validate_typed
nodes.summary: Validates a TypedValue's type ID, expected type and schema version against its schema and applies `concorde-main-request` action rules.

nodes.name: artifact
nodes.summary: Builds an artifact reference with the file's SHA-256 digest, requiring the file to exist.

nodes.name: verify_artifacts
nodes.summary: Recursively checks that every artifact reference in a value still matches its file bytes.

nodes.name: json_schema
nodes.summary: Exports a self-contained Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for a type ID with expanded `$defs`.

nodes.name: DiagramError
nodes.summary: ValueError raised for Mermaid diagram statements the validator cannot parse.

nodes.name: _scan_node
nodes.summary: Scans one Mermaid node token with its shape delimiters and label from a statement.

nodes.name: flowchart_model
nodes.summary: Parses a Mermaid flowchart into node labels and (source, label, target) edges, supporting arrow styles and inline labels.

nodes.name: _section_ranges
nodes.summary: Computes heading section ranges and walked lines for a Markdown body.

nodes.name: _fences_in_range
nodes.summary: Returns fences of a given language within a line range.

nodes.name: module_findings
nodes.summary: Reports registry and reading-structure problems of each Module's documents.

nodes.name: definition_findings
nodes.summary: Checks requirement, scenario, entity and contract definitions: identity uniqueness, placement by role, anchors, file listings and pending markers.

nodes.name: architecture_findings
nodes.summary: Checks Relationships diagrams: entity-title labels, labeled edges and parseability.

nodes.name: unlisted_file_findings
nodes.summary: Warns about project source files not bound by any Module entity.

nodes.name: document_context_findings
nodes.summary: Checks document-unit context resolution and source availability for every Module.

nodes.name: module_dependency_findings
nodes.summary: Checks that dependency explanations match registered children and uses exactly once.

nodes.name: terminology_findings
nodes.summary: Checks Terminology tables and that imported term links resolve to a `#terminology` table inside the Module's context.

nodes.name: link_findings
nodes.summary: Checks local Markdown links and stable-ID fragments against definitions in addressed registered documents.

nodes.name: verification_findings
nodes.summary: Scans bound tests for scenario declarations, reporting unknown IDs, malformed declarations and uncovered scenarios for file-bearing Modules.

nodes.name: validate_repository
nodes.summary: Top-level validator: loads the repository, checks canonical contracts and complementary bindings, aggregates all finding families plus Issue and package inputs, and returns a ToolResult with source digest and claims.

nodes.name: verifies
nodes.summary: Decorator recording scenario IDs on a test function without changing it.

nodes.name: Verification
nodes.summary: Frozen declaration record: scenario ID, test path, line and test name.

nodes.name: DeclarationError
nodes.summary: ValueError for unreadable test files or malformed declarations, carrying path and line.

nodes.name: _declarations
nodes.summary: Walks a Python AST collecting `verifies` decorator arguments on module-level functions and class methods, skipping nested helpers.

nodes.name: _typescript_title
nodes.summary: Finds the title literal of the next it/test/describe call, handling `.each` tables and multi-line calls.

nodes.name: _typescript_declarations
nodes.summary: Reads own-line `// verifies:` comments in TypeScript and binds their scenario IDs to the following test title.

nodes.name: scan_declarations
nodes.summary: Scans given Python and TypeScript test files for scenario declarations without importing or executing them.

nodes.name: obj
nodes.summary: Builds a closed JSON object schema whose required fields are all properties not listed as optional.

nodes.name: array
nodes.summary: Builds a JSON array schema with optional uniqueItems.

nodes.name: type_version
nodes.summary: Returns the schema version for a typed value type ID (context snapshots, discovery contexts, stage contexts, responses and others).

nodes.name: typed_schema
nodes.summary: Builds the TypedValue envelope schema referencing a type's data schema.

nodes.name: _origin_repository
nodes.summary: Derives a GitHub repository URL from the project's `.git/config` origin remote, if safe and recognizable.

nodes.name: _resolve_identity
nodes.summary: Resolves the docsite identity (title, repository, URL, base URL), producing a finding when values cannot be derived.

nodes.name: _proposal_entries
nodes.summary: Lists the exact files a scaffold proposes: adapter template files, site identity and optionally the GitHub Pages workflow.

nodes.name: _detect_prerequisites
nodes.summary: Detects local site prerequisites such as Node and package manager availability.

nodes.name: _prerequisite_findings
nodes.summary: Converts missing prerequisites into warning findings.

nodes.name: propose_docsite
nodes.summary: Builds a docsite scaffold proposal for an initialized project, returning invalid, unchanged or proposal results with conflicts and prerequisites.

nodes.name: _load_accepted
nodes.summary: Loads an accepted proposal from a safe project path and re-derives its exact file contents, rejecting a changed template digest.

nodes.name: apply_docsite
nodes.summary: Applies an accepted docsite proposal creation-only: unchanged when exact, conflict when targets exist, otherwise a staged file transaction.

nodes.name: DocsiteTemplateError
nodes.summary: ValueError for a missing, unsafe or manifest-inconsistent docsite template root.

nodes.name: _walk
nodes.summary: Recursively yields template files in sorted order, skipping excluded directories and rejecting symlinks.

nodes.name: verify_package_root
nodes.summary: Confirms the package manifest declares `docsite` in package_roots and the template root is a real directory.

nodes.name: template_files
nodes.summary: Returns every packaged docsite template file with an allowed suffix, keyed by package-relative path.

nodes.name: adapter_files
nodes.summary: Returns the template files minus scaffold-only entries.

nodes.name: workflow_template
nodes.summary: Returns the bytes of the packaged GitHub Pages deployment workflow template.

nodes.name: template_digest
nodes.summary: Computes a deterministic digest over a sorted path-to-content-hash manifest.

nodes.name: UaAnalysisError
nodes.summary: ValueError for native UA host admission, execution or output-check failures.

nodes.name: _source_snapshot
nodes.summary: Records a digest snapshot of the project's source state so output freshness can be checked.

nodes.name: _context
nodes.summary: Builds per-Module complete Spec context indexes and implementation file lists for the native analyzers.

nodes.name: _seed
nodes.summary: Derives the registry seed graph for native UA analysis using the UA graph exporter.

nodes.name: _prompt
nodes.summary: Renders the full native analysis prompt describing inputs, context indexes, seed rules and completion reporting.
