nodes.name: runtime_install_environment
nodes.summary: Returns an offline pip environment that points at the local index and puts fake node and npm tools first on PATH.

nodes.name: _create_viewer_tools
nodes.summary: Generates executable fake node and npm scripts (with Windows shims) that report versions and, on npm ci, materialize pi-subagents or the UA viewer package.

nodes.name: _graph_source
nodes.summary: Returns the source of a minimal StateGraph and compiled-graph stub that follows linear edges and appends capability_results.

nodes.name: AgentFlowTests
nodes.summary: Loads the docsite flow module once and checks capability graph coverage, factory sources, loop variant edges, page step explanations, and exclusion from the consumer inventory.

nodes.name: DocsiteScaffoldTests
nodes.summary: Twenty-one tests covering docsite proposal validity, determinism, identity defaults, overrides, workflow templates, conflicts, idempotent apply, rejection of stale or tampered proposals, and CLI round trips.

nodes.name: DocsiteTemplateFakePackageTests
nodes.summary: Tests the template inventory, adapter filtering, the workflow template, digest behavior, symlink rejection and package-root verification on a fake package.

nodes.name: DocsiteTemplateRealRepositoryTests
nodes.summary: Checks that the real docsite inventory includes the stable files, excludes disposable and project-owned paths, and has a stable digest.

nodes.name: write_fake_package
nodes.summary: Writes a fake concorde.json and a docsite tree with disposable, test, scaffold and project-owned files for inventory tests.

nodes.name: RepositoryCheckPreparationTests
nodes.summary: Tests scratch preparation of the repository checks with and without stale installations, and that a failed install stops the checks.

nodes.name: UaAnalysisTests
nodes.summary: Seventeen tests that drive analyze_ua and the CLI with a fake native host to check preparation, probe gating, consent, output gates, failure diagnostics, locking and path safety.

nodes.name: UaGraphSkeletonTests
nodes.summary: Checks that skeleton export derives only from the registry, and that layer replacement does not need a module-ID prefix.

nodes.name: UaGraphOverlayTests
nodes.summary: Checks that the overlay reuses existing nodes, is idempotent, preserves foreign data and extension fields, and rejects foreign ID collisions.

nodes.name: UaGraphSharedFileTests
nodes.summary: Checks that a file shared by two Modules belongs to the first lister's layer and gets a related edge.

nodes.name: UaGraphCheckTests
nodes.summary: Checks that --check passes on a current graph and fails on a stale one.

nodes.name: UaGraphInvalidInputTests
nodes.summary: Checks that malformed graphs, malformed records and a preferred graph directory are rejected without writing or falling back.

nodes.name: UaGraphCliTests
nodes.summary: Runs the ua-graph export through the Concorde CLI as a round trip.

nodes.name: _target
nodes.summary: Builds a registry target record with sorted files and empty checks and references.

nodes.name: build_project
nodes.summary: Initializes a fixture project and writes a Root/Alpha/Beta registry (with a shared file and a pending file) together with its Spec documents and sources.

nodes.name: CapabilityHost
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one host invocation's trusted execution context: project and package roots, mode, optional executor and observer, lifecycle flags, invocation and root-invocation identities, and the collected policy descriptions, evidence and lifecycle status; it rejects symlinked roots and never lets an observer failure turn a completed mutation into a retryable error.

nodes.name: MainInvocation
nodes.summary: Global Module discovery for discovering capabilities: it admits the project entry Module, freezes a discovery context per step, launches the router, answerer or topology-designer worker, validates that each outcome's fields match its phase, supplies the discovery Flow's node bindings, and turns the final decision into a routed target, a direct answer or a digest-bound topology proposal.

nodes.name: Invocation
nodes.summary: Execution of one target-bound capability: it selects the owning Module, freezes and rechecks per-stage context, compiles the stage policy, launches the stage worker, and implements Spec authoring, planning, task authoring, implementation including component coordination, deterministic validation, readiness and completion verification plus the development loop's node bindings, recording gaps and revision-bound evidence throughout.

nodes.name: _worker_invocation
nodes.summary: Binds one worker launch: resolves the worker profile, checks the declared child-capability composition and builds the digest-bound invocation from the frozen context, receipt, policy, binding, Protocol-appended instructions and the worker's and children's model selections.

nodes.name: _worker_description
nodes.summary: Builds the describe-policy record of one worker launch: its read and write grants, policy, binding, profile and instruction digests, workspace, tools, children and selected model, thinking level and timeout.

nodes.name: _run_worker
nodes.summary: Runs a bound worker with a report-only Issue reporter, keeps accepted reports even when the run fails, refuses an outcome not bound to this invocation and binding, records usage and validates the typed result and every Issue reference it carries.

nodes.name: _check_service
nodes.summary: Builds the host run_checks callback a project-workspace worker may call: it re-runs the Module's configured checks and returns each status with the tail of its host-owned log.

nodes.name: resolve_child_capability
nodes.summary: Resolves the module of a nested capability without executing anything, refusing unknown capabilities and any child that the parent capability's declared USES relation does not name; recursive self-invocation is allowed.

nodes.name: invoke_capability
nodes.summary: Wire adapter for in-process composition: checks the declared USES edge and runs the child capability's State-based run through the host node boundary.

nodes.name: _worktree
nodes.summary: Binds the invocation's workspace: it verifies change ownership, reuses an existing candidate worktree, or for a mutating request on primary creates a candidate worktree and returns the handoff marker instead of continuing in the originating session.

nodes.name: _check_revision
nodes.summary: Digests what a configured check measures: the Module's implementation, each check definition and the bytes of its declared inputs, and the check execution policy, refusing symlinked check inputs.

nodes.name: _check
nodes.summary: Runs every configured check of a Module through the sandboxed check executor, writes host-only logs under .concorde/runs, fails closed when the read-only sandbox is unavailable, and rejects evidence when validation changed the implementation it measured.

nodes.name: _inspect_topology_design
nodes.summary: Validates everything knowable about a topology design before authoring: candidate registry admission, unchanged project identity, Spec tasks for every changed target, document-ownership and shared file-listing changes, dependency changes and whether the design admitted the Specs of every affected Module.

nodes.name: _validate_topology_proposal
nodes.summary: Re-verifies a topology proposal against the current repository: its digest identity, registry base, Protocol binding and the discovery context identity it was designed under.

nodes.name: _topology_author
nodes.summary: Runs one fresh topology-author worker for a candidate target in its own capsule and requires a complete, ordered document replacement set, consistent blockers and outcome, and an unchanged registry, context and configuration afterwards.

nodes.name: _main_topology_response
nodes.summary: Builds the typed main response for the accept-topology and apply-topology actions, carrying the proposal, application reference, applied files and blockers.

nodes.name: _review_candidate_contexts
nodes.summary: Reviews every Module context a candidate overlay changes before any byte is applied, running each Spec review in its own contract through the sequential work-items Flow and recording reusable owner and consumer evidence plus task gaps.

nodes.name: _topology_nodes
nodes.summary: Node bindings of the topology preparation Flow: order authors so providers precede consumers, author each candidate Module, validate the complete candidate repository, review every affected context and persist a digest-bound topology application for the developer to accept.

nodes.name: _topology_apply_nodes
nodes.summary: Node bindings of the topology application Flow: admit and re-verify the stored application and its exact candidate registry and document set, validate it, apply every change atomically while updating the change record, and clean up the proposal artifact.

nodes.name: _project_nodes
nodes.summary: Node bindings of the project Flow: select configuration, an initialization proposal or its application, write capability configuration (optionally rebinding the installed Protocol) and return the typed response.

nodes.name: _dispatch_nodes
nodes.summary: Node bindings of the dispatch Flow and its subflows: capability selection, target admission with optional discovery, owner binding and, per leaf, delivery, project operations, answers, topology design, preparation and application, review scope, policy description, Issues, and the bound Spec, plan, task, implementation, validation and loop stages.

nodes.name: run_capability
nodes.summary: Public entry point that builds and invokes the capability admission Flow for one capability and returns its typed result envelope, routing a scheduler failure through the same failure path.

nodes.name: finish_failed_capability_flow
nodes.summary: Records a scheduler failure through the Flow's own fail and finalize nodes so the typed error envelope and final lifecycle evidence are still produced.

nodes.name: capability_flow_nodes
nodes.summary: Fresh trusted node bindings of the capability admission Flow: initialize, admit the request against the registered contracts and build freshness, bind the workspace and possibly raise the session handoff, check the configuration against project settings, run the guarded dispatch subflow nodes and finalize the result envelope with lifecycle progress.

nodes.name: validate_invocation
nodes.summary: Validates the shared CLI and Studio invocation envelope: exact schema-3 fields, type identity and the capability this entry point serves.

nodes.name: invocation_failure
nodes.summary: Builds the blocked result envelope used when a request fails before any host is selected, shared by the CLI and Studio entries.

nodes.name: json_main
nodes.summary: The executable boundary every Skill launcher shares: it reads one bounded JSON invocation from stdin, runs it in process or through a Studio server, prints described policies and the run's usage summary to stderr and the canonical result to stdout, and returns a process exit status.

nodes.name: admit_configuration
nodes.summary: Admits a value as the typed capability configuration and checks that every worker and child names a runnable Pi model selection.

nodes.name: load_configuration
nodes.summary: Reads and admits the project's capability configuration from .concorde/config.json, refusing a symlinked project root and reporting missing settings as a configuration mismatch.

nodes.name: propose_configuration
nodes.summary: Returns an unchanged result or a version-1 configuration proposal carrying the admitted configuration and the sha256 digest of the settings file it was computed from.

nodes.name: apply_configuration
nodes.summary: Applies an accepted configuration proposal atomically through a temporary file and os.replace, refusing an unsupported proposal shape or settings bytes that changed after the proposal or during the apply.

nodes.name: DispatchState
nodes.summary: Typed dispatch state: the selected route, the capability's typed output and a terminal failure envelope.

nodes.name: build_dispatch_flow
nodes.summary: Builds dispatch_flow for the complete topology or for one capability's reachable entry and bound leaves, embedding the query, topology, plan, project, issues, loop, specification and target-admission subflows and exposing each of them for Studio inspection.

nodes.name: _changes
nodes.summary: Computes the unified diffs a reviewer may see: only the target's own Spec sources or bound implementation files against the candidate baseline, read through Git object commands and skipping unchanged blobs.

nodes.name: inputs
nodes.summary: Builds the review input and its digest: mode, Spec and implementation revisions, baseline and head, the scoped changes, the reviewer's instructions and effects, its binding digest, the digests of the host runtime files and the configuration.

nodes.name: _persist
nodes.summary: Writes one review result artifact under the run directory with its private execution record, and records the review in the change state, invalidating a ready receipt when the review was lifecycle-required.

nodes.name: _validate
nodes.summary: Checks a reviewer's returned result: matching context, input and mode identities, meaningful answer and representative tasks, unique finding identities, and status consistent with the findings.

nodes.name: review
nodes.summary: Runs exactly one reviewer for a target and mode: it freezes the context, compiles a policy with no write authority, launches the reviewer through the capability node, validates and rechecks every admitted input, persists the result and converts findings into blockers and a review outcome.

nodes.name: _failed_review
nodes.summary: Preserves an interrupted or failed review as an incomplete persisted result, propagating cancellation or limit status without retracting already acknowledged Issue observations.

nodes.name: spec_consumers
nodes.summary: Finds every Module whose Spec context includes this target's documents now or at the candidate's base commit, reconstructing the old registry and documents from Git objects and adding recorded impacts.

nodes.name: consumer_intent
nodes.summary: The single review intent a Spec consumer is asked under, both before and after the change applies, so candidate and post-apply evidence can be matched.

nodes.name: changed_implementation_paths
nodes.summary: Lists the target's bound implementation files that differ from the candidate baseline, or none when no baseline is known.

nodes.name: code_review_peers
nodes.summary: Returns the other file-bearing Modules whose listings cover an implementation file that actually changed, or every covering Module when no base revision is known.

nodes.name: review_scope
nodes.summary: Reviews the owner and then every Spec consumer, coordinated component or changed-file peer in its own context through the sequential work-items Flow, reusing current revision-bound evidence in a composed continuation and recording the shared review records the lifecycle later verifies.

nodes.name: skip
nodes.summary: Persists an explicitly skipped review result when fast-loop review is disabled.

nodes.name: _current_artifact
nodes.summary: Returns a stored review result only when its artifact, Issue receipts, input digest, identity, status and representative tasks still validate and no attributed gap was recorded after it.

nodes.name: current
nodes.summary: Looks up the target's recorded review for one mode and returns it only when it is still current, optionally failing with review_required.

nodes.name: _spec_consumer_artifacts
nodes.summary: Returns the current Spec review artifacts of every consumer, each matched against an admissible producer task variant, or none when any is missing or stale.

nodes.name: current_spec_scope
nodes.summary: Returns the owner's and every consumer's current Spec review artifacts so a continuation can reuse the complete Spec scope, or none.

nodes.name: _code_peer_artifacts
nodes.summary: Returns the current code reviews of every peer sharing a changed file, each validated under its own intent and input digest, or none.

nodes.name: current_code_scope
nodes.summary: Returns the owner's current code review together with every changed-file peer's, or none when any is stale.

nodes.name: require_reviews
nodes.summary: Records the review intent and the sticky Spec and code review requirements for this target, so a resumed fast loop cannot silently downgrade a previously required review.

nodes.name: verify_required
nodes.summary: Verifies before readiness that every required owner, Spec consumer and shared-implementation peer review is present, non-blocking and current, including for directly authored candidates without target plans.

nodes.name: SkillPrompt
nodes.summary: One rendered instruction projection: name, description, source path, body and, for worker projections, its effects and complete WorkerProfile binding.

nodes.name: ModelInstructions
nodes.summary: The admitted worker projection: a SkillPrompt that always carries explicit effects and a complete binding.

nodes.name: BuildError
nodes.summary: Build failure carrying a stable code such as invalid_build or stale_build, which callers fail closed on.

nodes.name: BuildOutput
nodes.summary: One rendered output: its project-relative path, exact bytes and the authored sources it was rendered from.

nodes.name: BuildResult
nodes.summary: The complete ordered set of build outputs together with the serialized build manifest.

nodes.name: _skill_metadata
nodes.summary: Reads and checks one skill source's front matter, requiring exactly the name, description and capability fields with the expected name.

nodes.name: render_model_instructions
nodes.summary: Renders one worker's instructions as the common worker rules followed by its own role Spec, binding every resolved source and child definition so a changed child makes the build stale.

nodes.name: _skill_frontmatter
nodes.summary: Builds the integration-specific Skill front matter, including the Claude invocation flags that decide whether the model may select the Skill or only the developer can.

nodes.name: render_skill
nodes.summary: Renders one public Skill for one integration: resolves the skill source, substitutes the launcher command, refuses unresolved package tokens and appends the capability's exported request schema.

nodes.name: render_langgraph
nodes.summary: Renders the Studio graph list that maps each public capability to its Studio entry module.

nodes.name: render_protocol_principles
nodes.summary: Renders the Protocol principles asset from its authored prompt source.

nodes.name: render_protocol_kind
nodes.summary: Renders one Protocol kind asset from its authored prompt source.

nodes.name: _root_schemas
nodes.summary: Evaluates a root's own schema sources in a private import namespace without stale module or bytecode caches, returning the rendered schemas, the sources they loaded and the exported identity sequence as declared.

nodes.name: render_protocol_schemas
nodes.summary: Renders the exported JSON schema document of the named root and binds every loaded schema source to that output.

nodes.name: _manifest
nodes.summary: Builds the build manifest: the sha256 of every contributing source, including capability declarations and wire contract modules, and of every rendered output with its sources.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Renders every worker projection, public Skill, Studio graph list and Protocol asset for the requested integrations, refuses unreachable prompt sources, and returns the ordered outputs with their manifest without writing anything.

nodes.name: write_build
nodes.summary: Renders and writes the build: generated outputs below the project root, Skill wrappers below an optional integration root, and removes files in build-owned generated directories that the current build no longer produces.

nodes.name: _owned_generated_tree
nodes.summary: Reads every build-owned path under generated/, so checks never judge another tool's files in that shared root.

nodes.name: check_build
nodes.summary: Renders into a temporary directory and reports every build-owned output that is missing, unexpected or byte-different, including the Skill wrappers and the tracked Protocol manifest digests, without modifying the project.

nodes.name: recompute_protocol_manifest
nodes.summary: Recomputes the digest of every tracked Protocol asset from the current rendered build and returns an updated manifest copy without writing it.

nodes.name: verify_fresh
nodes.summary: Cheap freshness gate: re-hashes every source the build manifest recorded and fails with a stale_build error when one is missing or changed, without rebuilding anything.

nodes.name: load_model_instructions
nodes.summary: Loads one worker's rendered instructions and complete binding from the current build, accepting the external, hyphenated or underscored worker name.

nodes.name: _validate_prompts
nodes.summary: Resolves every prompt root, reports unreachable prompt files and flags every concorde-* token in prompts, skill sources and worker Specs that names no skill, capability, worker or exported type.

nodes.name: _load_capabilities_package
nodes.summary: Loads a root's capabilities/__init__.py under a fresh private module name so a temporary fixture package can be validated without colliding with the running checkout's inventory.

nodes.name: _capability_modules
nodes.summary: Returns the root's capability inventory and each declared capability module, recording an import failure as a missing module rather than crashing.

nodes.name: _skill_capabilities
nodes.summary: Maps each capability name to the skill directories whose SKILL.md front matter declares it, discovering whatever skills exist at the given root.

nodes.name: _validate_capability_modules
nodes.summary: Validates the capability inventory against the module files and every module's mandatory constants, context selection, USES edges, State contract, external name, Skill pairing, and checks the composition graph for cycles and for determinism and context selection consistent with transitive model use.

nodes.name: _validate_agent_profile
nodes.summary: Validates one worker profile's internal consistency, that its contract types are exported, and that its declared children are exactly the child definition files that exist.

nodes.name: _validate_worker_profiles
nodes.summary: Checks every capability's optional execution profile: its identity, the Spec path, the required H1 identity and the exact six role-Spec headings, prompt resolvability and the profile itself.

nodes.name: _validate_contracts
nodes.summary: Compares the rendered schema export with the schemas this root's own sources produce and flags duplicate exported type identities.

nodes.name: _registered_documents
nodes.summary: Reads the text of every Markdown path the registry's targets declare, distinguishing a missing registry from an otherwise invalid one that the deterministic Spec validator reports.

nodes.name: _metadata_inventories
nodes.summary: Collects one named extension payload from the metadata companion of every registered document.

nodes.name: _capability_code_inventory
nodes.summary: Derives from code the inventory a Spec must declare for each capability: exposure, context selection, determinism, skill, USES, State types and the optional execution profile.

nodes.name: _validate_spec_capabilities_block
nodes.summary: Requires exactly one well-formed concorde.capabilities metadata inventory and reconciles it entry by entry with the capability declarations in code.

nodes.name: _validate_spec_types
nodes.summary: Checks that every versioned concorde-*@N token in the boundary document names an exported identity at that exact version and that every exported identity appears there.

nodes.name: _raised_error_codes
nodes.summary: Collects every code-shaped literal passed to an *Error call or an inline code field under src/concorde by walking the AST, so prose messages are never mistaken for codes.

nodes.name: _validate_spec_errors
nodes.summary: Advisory check that every error code raised in the package appears in the boundary document's error table.

nodes.name: _validate_spec_alignment
nodes.summary: Runs the registry-backed Spec alignment checks: the capability inventory, versioned types and the error table.

nodes.name: _validate_build_outputs
nodes.summary: Checks build freshness and then that rebuilding into a temporary directory reproduces the recorded outputs exactly.

nodes.name: validate_package
nodes.summary: Validates the whole package in one pass: prompts, capability modules, worker profiles, contracts, Spec alignment and build outputs, returning every finding.

nodes.name: PromptResolverError
nodes.summary: A prompt source violated one deterministic resolution rule, carrying the stable rule identity that becomes the validator finding.

nodes.name: ResolvedPrompt
nodes.summary: One fully substituted root prompt together with the exact sources that contributed to it.

nodes.name: _safe_relative
nodes.summary: Requires an include target to be a safe repository-relative POSIX path with no absolute, traversal or backslash components.

nodes.name: _parse_prompt_file
nodes.summary: Reads one file under prompts/ and returns its audience and body, treating Protocol text as shared and rejecting unknown or missing audience metadata.

nodes.name: _parse_directive
nodes.summary: Parses one @include directive into its target path and unique key=value variable bindings.

nodes.name: _check_scope
nodes.summary: Enforces inclusion scope: no skill sources or Spec documents, worker Specs may include only prompts/, and Protocol prompts and ordinary prompts cannot include each other.

nodes.name: _substitute
nodes.summary: Substitutes bound {KEY} variables in an included body, leaving reserved package tokens for the build and failing on an unbound variable.

nodes.name: _resolve_body
nodes.summary: Walks a body line by line, expanding each @include with its bindings while rejecting include cycles and a target reached twice within one root, and records every contributing source.

nodes.name: resolve_role_prompt
nodes.summary: Resolves one role root prompt whose own front matter declares the worker or shared audience and returns its substituted body with its sources.

nodes.name: resolve_skill_source
nodes.summary: Resolves one skills/<name>/SKILL.md body as an implicit ambient root after checking its exact front-matter fields.

nodes.name: resolve_model_instructions
nodes.summary: Resolves one worker Spec as an implicit worker root that carries no front matter, rejecting a front-matter fence outright.

nodes.name: find_unreachable_prompts
nodes.summary: Returns every prompts/**/*.md file that no given root reaches, that is, dead prompt text.

nodes.name: check_reachability
nodes.summary: Raises the unreachable-prompt rule when some prompt file is dead text given these roots.

nodes.name: typed_state
nodes.summary: Declares a TypedDict admitting exactly the channels of one registered type, leaving value checking to runtime validation.

nodes.name: state_schema
nodes.summary: Builds the combined input and output TypedDict of a capability node, falling back to the host result channel when the capability declares no output type.

nodes.name: CapabilityNode
nodes.summary: Resolves a registered Capability by identity and exposes its declared State schemas and a compiled one-node subgraph, validating the admitted input and the returned result while host launchers stay in trusted Runtime context rather than State.

nodes.name: ResultState
nodes.summary: The single result channel through which a host-backed graph preserves success, rejection and failure.

nodes.name: StateContract
nodes.summary: One Capability's declared input and optional output type, resolving their TypedDict schemas lazily so the declaration stays dependency free.

nodes.name: CapabilityContext
nodes.summary: The trusted, invocation-local runtime context carrying the host, configuration or model launcher; it is never a State channel.

nodes.name: run_model
nodes.summary: Runs a model-backed Capability under its own contract: it types and validates the input, calls the trusted launcher and validates the returned result, refusing a node compiled only for inspection.

nodes.name: run_host
nodes.summary: Adapts State to the existing public host wire boundary and returns the complete capability result envelope, preserving failure evidence.

nodes.name: CheckResult
nodes.summary: One check's captured stdout, stderr, exit code and whether it timed out.

nodes.name: CheckSandboxError
nodes.summary: Enforcement is unavailable or broke down; the captured output stays with the calling host rather than becoming an ordinary check failure.

nodes.name: CheckBackend
nodes.summary: The trusted backend interface a check runs through; it is host-selected, never chosen by a registry or task.

nodes.name: BubblewrapBackend
nodes.summary: The Linux backend: it starts bubblewrap with user, PID and IPC namespaces over a read-only host bind and one writable scratch, blocks the command until its namespace PID 1 is pinned by a pidfd, drains output while waiting, and kills the whole namespace on timeout or exit before trusting the reported exit code.

nodes.name: _pidfd_call
nodes.summary: Calls pidfd_open or pidfd_send_signal through Python or, where the wrappers are missing, through libc, so cleanup never falls back to signalling a reusable numeric PID.

nodes.name: _bubblewrap
nodes.summary: Locates a root-owned system bubblewrap whose whole path is trusted and not group or world writable, refusing a project-provided binary or PATH shim.

nodes.name: _read_info
nodes.summary: Reads bubblewrap's setup metadata from its info descriptor within the deadline and requires a valid sandbox child process id.

nodes.name: execute_check
nodes.summary: Runs one check with a fresh scratch directory outside the project and a scrubbed environment, refusing non-Linux hosts, unisolatable project locations and invalid commands or timeouts.

nodes.name: ContextSnapshot
nodes.summary: The frozen serialized context of one bounded invocation, exposing its decoded value and its digest identity.

nodes.name: DiscoveryContext
nodes.summary: The frozen multi-Module discovery context, with every source indexed and granted once for global reasoning.

nodes.name: TopologyAuthorContext
nodes.summary: The frozen private authoring context of one provisional or existing topology target.

nodes.name: _implementation_entries
nodes.summary: Lists the Module's declared implementation listing entries with their owning entity, pending marker and whether they are directories; declarations only, never contents.

nodes.name: _implementation_files
nodes.summary: Resolves the implementation context's file names: every bound existing file with its most specific owning entity, plus files declared pending.

nodes.name: materialize_references
nodes.summary: Copies a snapshot's external references into a capsule at their project-relative paths, limited to the readable files the entry digest covers.

nodes.name: context_grants
nodes.summary: Returns the read-only paths a context index grants: every listed Spec document and the installed Protocol files, for any of the three context kinds.

nodes.name: context_documents
nodes.summary: Returns the exact bytes of every granted context file keyed by path, verifying each digest and drawing overridden documents from a candidate repository, so a stale grant is rejected instead of read.

nodes.name: materialize_documents
nodes.summary: Copies the granted context files into a capsule byte for byte at their project-relative paths.

nodes.name: resolve_context
nodes.summary: Freezes one Module-bound invocation context: phase and worker contract checks, admitted stage inputs, the Module's complete Spec resolution, implementation entries, file names and, in code phases, artifact bytes, external references, Protocol files and workspace, identified by one digest.

nodes.name: resolve_discovery_context
nodes.summary: Freezes the complete Spec contexts of several admitted Modules for global reasoning, pooling each physical source once, admitting exact topology metadata only for topology design and never any file contents.

nodes.name: resolve_topology_author_context
nodes.summary: Freezes one topology target's private authoring context from the accepted candidate descriptor, including existing owned sources and explicit references while new owned paths stay unwritten.

nodes.name: _stale_on_resolution_error
nodes.summary: Decorator making every recheck report a formerly admitted selection that no longer resolves as stale context rather than as a new resolution error or grant.

nodes.name: recheck_context
nodes.summary: Rechecks a frozen invocation context: its own identity, the workspace, the Protocol binding, the Module's Spec resolution bytes and provenance, the implementation entries and names, code-phase artifact bytes and external references.

nodes.name: recheck_discovery_context
nodes.summary: Re-resolves every admitted Module and rejects any changed discovery input by comparing the complete serialized context.

nodes.name: recheck_topology_author_context
nodes.summary: Re-resolves the topology authoring context, including the candidate overlay, and rejects any change.

nodes.name: assess_result
nodes.summary: Validates a context assessment against its snapshot identity and permitted outcomes and rejects an outcome that contradicts its Issue blockers.

nodes.name: EffectDeclaration
nodes.summary: The integration-neutral authority one launchable worker identity declares: the path roles it reads and writes plus its network and credential posture.

nodes.name: WorkerSelection
nodes.summary: One resolved Pi selection: model, thinking level and timeout, with the wire form the invocation carries.

nodes.name: worker_selection
nodes.summary: Resolves one worker's or child's selection by narrowing the configuration default with the worker entry and then the child entry, value by value.

nodes.name: validate_worker_selections
nodes.summary: Rejects configuration override keys that name no worker or child, timeouts declared on a child, non-positive timeouts and model names that are not Pi provider/id identities.

nodes.name: PolicyBinding
nodes.summary: The host-issued narrowing binding of one launch: capability, stage, occurrence, role and worker plus the optional narrower read and write roles, network and credential requests.

nodes.name: NormalizedPolicy
nodes.summary: The compiled, digest-bound policy of one launch: its identity, read, write and deny paths, default-deny posture, network and credential decision and whether an outer sandbox is required.

nodes.name: _role_selection
nodes.summary: Selects the effective path roles of a binding, refusing duplicates, unknown roles and any role that widens the contract's declared effects.

nodes.name: compile_policy
nodes.summary: Compiles one worker contract's effects, its narrowing binding and the concrete role paths into a frozen digest-bound policy, requiring writes to be readable and covered, adding credential deny paths and refusing any network or credential widening.

nodes.name: verify_effective_subset
nodes.summary: Rejects an effective policy that widens the declared readable or writable paths, removes deny paths or relaxes the default-deny, network or credential posture.

nodes.name: PiRun
nodes.summary: Everything one Pi process reported: its events, tool results, session statistics, stderr, exit code and wall time, with a helper for the results of one tool.

nodes.name: _records
nodes.summary: Reads the process stdout stream into LF-delimited records, dropping an optional trailing carriage return and signalling end of file to the consumer queue.

nodes.name: run_prompt
nodes.summary: Runs one prompt to settlement: sends the prompt command, observes every record until the agent settles, answers interactive dialogs as cancelled, reads session statistics, and turns deadlines, interruption and protocol faults into distinct errors while always stopping the process.

nodes.name: WorkerExecutionError
nodes.summary: A worker launch was refused, failed, was cancelled, ran out of time or returned no usable result; the outcome classifies which, and the run is retained when there is one.

nodes.name: ChildAgent
nodes.summary: One lightweight child: its name and the complete pi-subagents Markdown definition the run directory receives.

nodes.name: WorkerLaunch
nodes.summary: Everything one worker process may use: workspace, system prompt, message, result schema, tools, read and write paths, children and their tools, model, thinking level, timeout and optional report schema.

nodes.name: WorkerResult
nodes.summary: The admitted submitted value together with the complete run record and its reported usage.

nodes.name: validate_launch
nodes.summary: Refuses an inconsistent launch: unknown or duplicated tools, a missing submit_result grant, delegation without declared children or the reverse, run_checks or report_issue without their host service, edit or write without a write grant, malformed child definitions, an unsupported thinking level, a missing workspace or a non-positive timeout.

nodes.name: _HostToolHandler
nodes.summary: Serves one framed host tool request over the private socket, answering only an exactly shaped run_checks or report_issue call that the launch granted and returning an explicit error otherwise.

nodes.name: _usage
nodes.summary: Normalizes Pi's reported session statistics into the usage record, keeping unreported or invalid figures null.

nodes.name: subagents_entry
nodes.summary: Locates the pi-subagents entry point in the source checkout's own install or in the provisioned managed runtime.

nodes.name: _return_refreshed_auth
nodes.summary: Carries an OAuth refresh Pi made inside the run back to the developer's credentials, but only when the copy changed, is a JSON object and the developer's file still holds the bytes the run was issued.

nodes.name: PiWorkerRuntime
nodes.summary: Runs worker launches: it validates the launch, builds the private run directory with Pi settings, copied credentials, child definitions and one-level delegation configuration, writes the enforced policy and system prompt, starts Pi in RPC mode with ambient discovery disabled and only the Concorde extension loaded, serves the host tools, and admits exactly one submitted JSON result.

nodes.name: StudioInput
nodes.summary: The Studio graph's input: the capability invocation and the optional expected workspace identity.

nodes.name: StudioOutput
nodes.summary: The Studio graph's output: the capability result, the described policies and the observed event log.

nodes.name: build_studio_flow
nodes.summary: Compiles one Studio graph for a public capability: it binds server-owned roots, validates the invocation and workspace on entry and on resume, builds a fresh observed host per run, executes the capability admission Flow as an exposed subflow and returns the result with policies and events even when execution fails.

nodes.name: usage_record
nodes.summary: Builds the labelled usage line for one worker launch: run and invocation identities, depth, capability, stage, target, worker, change, iteration, context identity, model and the reported usage.

nodes.name: record_usage
nodes.summary: Appends one usage line to the run's file and announces it to the host observer, swallowing persistence errors so accounting never fails a completed launch.

nodes.name: read_usage
nodes.summary: Reads back every recorded usage line for one run or for all runs under the project, skipping unreadable or malformed lines.

nodes.name: summarize_usage
nodes.summary: Summarizes usage lines into totals plus per-step, stage, target, worker and run breakdowns, counting launches that reported nothing.

nodes.name: CapabilityExecutionError
nodes.summary: A worker invocation was refused, failed, was cancelled, timed out or returned an invalid result; the outcome classifies why, an optional code preserves a contract rejection class and usage is retained.

nodes.name: ExecutionUsage
nodes.summary: What one worker consumed as Pi reported it, with null for figures Pi did not report; it is diagnostic evidence and never gates a result.

nodes.name: WorkerInvocation
nodes.summary: The immutable, digest-identified launch record: capability, stage, worker, invocation id, workspace, canonical context and receipt, compiled policy, binding, instructions and model selections.

nodes.name: WorkerOutcome
nodes.summary: The admitted worker result with its usage and the invocation and binding digests it is bound to.

nodes.name: worker_instructions
nodes.summary: Composes a worker's system prompt: its rendered instructions followed by each Protocol file the context lists.

nodes.name: result_parameters
nodes.summary: Expands a result type into the self-contained JSON schema the worker's submit_result tool receives, rejecting recursive schemas.

nodes.name: build_worker_invocation
nodes.summary: Binds one invocation's identities into a digest-bound record, refusing a policy that does not match the capability, stage and worker, non-canonical context or receipt serialization, a receipt without its context identity and role paths, or a missing identity or relative workspace.

nodes.name: WorkerExecutor
nodes.summary: Runs verified worker invocations: preflight re-derives the binding from the current build, verifies the granted Protocol bytes, the rendered instructions and the contract's context and policy admission and refuses network, credential or undeclared write grants, then launches the Pi runtime with the contract's tools, children and child selections and admits only a result that validates against the contract.

nodes.name: ContractError
nodes.summary: A worker result violated its profile's contract; the code preserves the host rejection class.

nodes.name: Contract
nodes.summary: One model node's execution constraints: phase, context and result types, declared effects, optional discovery action, admitted and required stage inputs, permitted result fields and outcomes.

nodes.name: Child
nodes.summary: One lightweight child a worker may delegate to, named by its Markdown definition path.

nodes.name: WorkerProfile
nodes.summary: One worker's optional execution profile: role Spec, task contract, workspace kind, tools, children and timeout.

nodes.name: ChildDefinition
nodes.summary: One parsed child definition: its name, description, tools and the complete authored text.

nodes.name: WorkerBinding
nodes.summary: The reproducible identity of one resolved worker against the current build: spec and instruction paths and digests, profile digest, build manifest digest, timeout and the binding digest itself.

nodes.name: worker_key
nodes.summary: Normalizes an external, hyphenated or underscored worker name to the inventory key.

nodes.name: validate_worker_profile
nodes.summary: Rejects a profile whose Spec path, workspace, context and result pairing, stage inputs, result fields, effects, tools, children or timeout are inconsistent, including implementation reads outside a project workspace and any network or credential effect.

nodes.name: child_definition
nodes.summary: Parses and checks one child's pi-subagents definition: its declared name, description and prompt, distinct permitted tools, context-free settings and no model or thinking level, which stay project configuration.

nodes.name: load_worker_profiles
nodes.summary: Derives the optional worker execution profiles from the single capability inventory, refusing a profile whose name differs from its capability.

nodes.name: worker_profile
nodes.summary: Looks up one worker profile by external, hyphenated or underscored name and fails with an unknown-agent build error.

nodes.name: validate_worker_artifacts
nodes.summary: Checks that a launch's stage inputs are unique, permitted by the contract and, when required, complete, including the task-scope feedback pairing.

nodes.name: validate_worker_input
nodes.summary: Admits a context against the profile's contract independently of prompt text: context type, phase and discovery action, stage inputs, absence of implementation contents for non-code workers, review mode and patch scope, and no extra expected artifacts.

nodes.name: validate_worker_output
nodes.summary: Validates a worker result against its contract: the result type, the permitted outcomes, the result fields the contract allows and the review mode.

nodes.name: validate_worker_policy
nodes.summary: Recompiles the concrete grant from the contract's effects and the receipt's role paths and checks it against the compiled policy: exactly one frozen context index with its listed files, implementation grants inside the Module's frozen listing, reference grants inside the snapshot's external references, and no widening.

nodes.name: profile_digest
nodes.summary: Digests the complete worker profile including the bytes of every child definition.

nodes.name: canonical_binding
nodes.summary: Canonical JSON of a binding without its own digest: the input the binding digest is computed over.

nodes.name: binding_from_json
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a binding from its wire JSON, rejecting malformed payloads.

nodes.name: resolve_worker
nodes.summary: Binds one worker profile to the current build: it verifies build freshness, validates the profile and its children, requires the role Spec and child definitions to match the recorded manifest digests and the rendered instructions to exist, and returns the digest-sealed binding.

nodes.name: load_capability_inventory
nodes.summary: Imports the repository-root capabilities package, adding the package root to the import path when needed.

nodes.name: capability_modules
nodes.summary: Loads every declared capability module keyed by its external name, independently of any registry dependency.

nodes.name: contracts
nodes.summary: Maps each capability that owns a wire envelope to its request and response type identities.

nodes.name: _capability_schemas
nodes.summary: Collects the REQUEST and RESPONSE schema of every capability module that declares one.

nodes.name: schemas
nodes.summary: Defines every exported JSON schema: Issue reports and receipts, stage inputs, the context snapshot with its Spec resolution, implementation entries, files, artifacts and external references, the discovery and topology-author contexts, review inputs and results, stage results and the topology design, proposal and application, merged with each capability's own request and response.

nodes.name: FrontMatterError
nodes.summary: A front-matter document violated the supported subset, carrying its source and line for the caller's message.

nodes.name: _scalar
nodes.summary: Parses one scalar of the supported subset (null, booleans, integers, JSON inline collections, quoted and plain strings) and rejects tags, anchors, aliases, merge keys and block scalars.

nodes.name: _meaningful
nodes.summary: Filters front-matter lines to meaningful tokens with their line number and indentation, rejecting tab indentation and odd indentation widths.

nodes.name: _parse_block
nodes.summary: Parses one indented block as a mapping or a list, including nested blocks and list items that carry mappings, and rejects unexpected indentation, duplicate keys and malformed entries.

nodes.name: parse_document
nodes.summary: Splits a Markdown document into its parsed front-matter mapping and body, requiring an opening and closing fence and a valid top-level mapping.

nodes.name: capabilityAnchor
nodes.summary: Maps a Capability key to its page anchor, special-casing concorde-dev-loop and concorde-specify-loop to the stable development and specify anchors and prefixing everything else with capability-.

nodes.name: flowNavigation
nodes.summary: Builds the three sidebar groups (Capabilities, Shared flows, Guides) from FlowData, pinning the dev-loop, specify-loop and specify capabilities first, sorting the remainder, and deriving a slug id for each shared Flow.

nodes.name: selectionFromHash
nodes.summary: Resolves a URL hash to a navigable entry id, honouring exact matches, legacy spec-stage-, stage-flow- and internal-stage- prefixes and the old flow-catalog anchor, and falling back to development when the hash is unknown or cannot be decoded.

nodes.name: filterNavigation
nodes.summary: Filters navigation groups so every whitespace-separated search word matches an entry's title, key or group title, dropping groups that end up empty.

nodes.name: Diagram
nodes.summary: React component that lays out one compiled LangGraph as accessible SVG: orders nodes between __start__ and __end__, positions them on a fixed grid, draws solid unconditional and dashed conditional edges with special routing for repair and stop transitions, and offers a reading-size toggle alongside a textual transition list.

nodes.name: StepCards
nodes.summary: Renders one anchored article card per execution step showing its kind badge, agent, detail prose, receives/produces/handoff definition list, stop conditions and a link to the owning Spec page.

nodes.name: CapabilityRelations
nodes.summary: Renders a Capability's declared facts (public Skill or composed, context selection, deterministic or model-calling), its input and output State channels, and anchor cross-links to the capabilities it calls and the capabilities that call it.

nodes.name: CapabilityFlows
nodes.summary: Default-exported Agent Flows page component: builds and filters the navigation groups, keeps the selected entry synchronized with the URL hash and scroll position, and renders the sidebar plus every loop, public capability, internal capability and shared Flow section with its diagram, step cards, relations and source provenance list.

nodes.name: agentFlows
nodes.summary: Docusaurus plugin factory that picks the project Python interpreter, loads compiled Flow data by executing flows.py, publishes it through createData and addRoute at baseUrl + agent-flows, declares watched factory sources, and throws in postBuild when any declared source digest changed during publication.

nodes.name: DiscoveryState
nodes.summary: Typed LangGraph state of the discovery Flow: the terminal result, the bounded occurrence counter, the worker's last decision, the bound routes and the selected next route.

nodes.name: build_discovery_flow
nodes.summary: Builds and compiles discovery_flow from caller-supplied node functions, routing on the decision's route and sending expand_context back to decide until a terminal result appears; compiled without a checkpointer.

nodes.name: QueryState
nodes.summary: Typed state of the query Flow: the discovery channels plus the terminal result and the main response output.

nodes.name: build_query_flow
nodes.summary: Builds query_flow with the discovery Flow as the discover subflow and a respond node, and exposes the compiled discovery subflow for stateless Studio inspection.

nodes.name: TargetState
nodes.summary: Typed state of target admission: discovery counters, decision and routes plus the selected route, terminal result and response output.

nodes.name: build_target_flow
nodes.summary: Builds target_flow with initialize_target and bind_target and, when discovery is enabled, an embedded discovery subflow whose result short-circuits binding; exposes that subflow for Studio.

nodes.name: merge_artifacts
nodes.summary: Reducer for the Flow's artifact channel: merges reference lists by artifact id so the newest reference per id wins while insertion order is preserved.

nodes.name: DevelopmentState
nodes.summary: Typed development Flow state: the selected route, the last stage's typed output, a terminal failure envelope and the reducer-merged artifact references.

nodes.name: loop_successors
nodes.summary: Maps each development stage to its successor for this run, entering after specify_loop at the resume stage and including review_code only when the Module lists implementation files.

nodes.name: loop_destinations
nodes.summary: Lists every node a stage may hand over to: its successor, the dynamic resume jumps from specify_loop, the validate-to-ready shortcut, the review_code repair edge back to tasks, and the summarize or END stop.

nodes.name: build_loop_flow
nodes.summary: Compiles development_flow from caller-supplied node functions with declared per-node destinations, adding the initialize and summarize nodes in dynamic mode and starting at specify_loop otherwise.

nodes.name: stage_command
nodes.summary: Builds the LangGraph Command a stage node returns: its typed state update plus the node it selected, with END redirected to summarize in dynamic mode.

nodes.name: SpecifyState
nodes.summary: Typed state of the specification Flow: the last stage's typed output, a terminal failure envelope and the reducer-merged artifact references shared with the development Flow.

nodes.name: build_specify_flow
nodes.summary: Compiles specify_flow with initialize, specify, review_spec and summarize nodes and their declared Command destinations, matching the Specification Flow Spec owned by module.specify-loop.

nodes.name: has_authored_spec
nodes.summary: Decides whether the change already carries an accepted authoring for this target under the same task, focus and constraints with no open specify-phase Issue blocker, so authoring can be skipped on resume.

nodes.name: specify_nodes
nodes.summary: Builds the host node functions for specify_flow: it makes Spec review sticky, routes initialize to authoring or review, and runs each observed stage by skipping, reusing current owner and consumer review scope, or invoking the concorde-specify/concorde-review child capability, recording lifecycle status and stop transitions before summarizing the capability response.

nodes.name: deploy-docsite.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that builds the project docsite and publishes it to GitHub Pages on pushes to main or manual dispatch: a build job optionally runs `python3 scripts/concorde.py build` when `scripts/concorde.py` exists (Framework source checkout), installs docsite npm dependencies, syncs the uv dev group so executable LangGraph factories can be inspected, runs the docsite build and uploads the Pages artifact, then a separate deploy job publishes it under the github-pages concurrency group. It is a workspace CI artifact, not owned or bound by any registered Module.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `hashFiles(...) != ''` step conditions so the same workflow works for a Concorde source checkout and for an ordinary scaffolded consumer that has no Framework build command.

nodes.name: validate-source-checkout.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that validates the Concorde source checkout on every pull request and push to main: the build job installs the uv dev group and bubblewrap (relaxing the AppArmor unprivileged-userns restriction so nested sandbox tests can run), runs `concorde.py build`, `build --check`, `validate` and the full Python unittest suite, then typechecks, tests and validates the docsite against the current build; a second studio job installs the optional studio group and runs the opt-in Studio graph, client and server tests with CONCORDE_TEST_STUDIO=1. It is a workspace CI artifact with no registered Module owner and no Module implementation binding — the same unbound-file gap that the archived R-071 diagnosis records for this path.
nodes.languageNotes: Inline shell steps install a system sandbox dependency and adjust a kernel sysctl, which only works because the runner is a disposable Ubuntu image.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Entry note for the archived Reflection history, stating that this directory preserves the former Reflection queue, allocation metadata and evidence byte for byte after the Issue-system refactor, that the four open records R-071 through R-074 were never reclassified, resolved or promoted into Issues, and that the archive is read-only historical material rather than an active queue, a repair authorization or current verification evidence. It is a branch-local working record, not a Spec document of any registered Module and not bound as any Module's implementation.

nodes.name: config.json
nodes.summary: Preserved settings of the retired Reflection queue: schema version 1, newest-first ordering, approval not required, an empty skip list, and the plans and worktrees directories the queue used. Not owned or bound by any registered Module. Observation: `plans_dir` and `worktrees_dir` still point at the original live `.concorde/reflections/` locations rather than at this archive copy, consistent with the README's byte-for-byte preservation claim.

nodes.name: index.json
nodes.summary: Preserved allocation index of the retired Reflection queue, recording schema version 1 and the high-water Reflection identifier R-074 that was the highest allocated record when the queue was archived. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-060-baseline-reviews.json
nodes.summary: Archived typed reports from four real, independent Spec-only reviewer sessions run on the installed Codex CLI before the R-060 contract repairs, each case carrying exact input digests, target and context identities, coverage, findings and native execution receipts. Its own purpose field declares it a historical baseline and explicitly not current readiness evidence. A branch-local Reflection evidence record, not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-060-code-cases.json
nodes.summary: Archived code-review effectiveness cases built on a seeded fixture pair — a defective `transfer` that returns the balance unchanged and a correct one that rejects non-positive or over-balance amounts — recording that both seeded behavior defects were reported and that the correct implementation produced no findings, together with the stated limits. Its purpose field declares these observations, not CI assertions or a whole-candidate review. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-060-contract-followups.json
nodes.summary: Archived follow-up reviewer observations recorded after the first round of R-060 contract repairs, covering the additional omissions the evaluation names — incomplete schema error semantics, publication preconditions, undiscoverable gap identifiers and the preparation/plugin source-identity gap — with exact input digests identifying the reviewed candidate bytes and no semantic-completeness claim. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-060-evaluation.md
nodes.summary: The R-060 implementation and evaluation report for candidate change.599d4ebe… on branch design/domain-scopes-and-spec-contexts: it describes the implemented independent Spec and code review modes, tabulates eleven real Codex reviewer observations with their interpretation, counts six observed misses among later-confirmed defects, states verification limits (no statistical reliability claim, semantic_completeness=not_proven), and reports the final green runs of 474 Python and 119 docsite tests. It is the hub document linking every other R-060 evidence file, and is a branch-local working record rather than a Spec document of any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-060-host-code-accepted.json
nodes.summary: Archived report of the final actual-host code review in the R-060 series, which the evaluation records as reporting no findings or gaps for the covered paths on the then-current source, tests and Spec inputs. Carries exact input digests and native Codex receipts, with the caveat that the static review did not execute checks. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-060-host-code-boundaries.json
nodes.summary: Archived report of the third actual-host code review in the R-060 series, which the evaluation records as reporting failed-preview persistence and a standalone dependent-step bypass, both later reproduced by regressions and repaired. Recorded from a real Codex run with input digests and native receipts, not a process double. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-060-host-code-checklist.json
nodes.summary: Archived report of the fourth actual-host code review in the R-060 series, which the evaluation records as finding that rejected checklist artifacts could resolve a prior gap; the defect was reproduced and repaired, along with the equivalent reflection-investigation path found by a local audit. Real Codex run with exact input digests and native receipts. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-060-host-code-followup.json
nodes.summary: Archived report of the second actual-host code review in the R-060 series, which the evaluation records as reporting two additional failure-recovery defects, each reproduced by a failing regression and repaired. Real Codex run with exact input digests and native receipts, on a different implementation revision from the other host reviews. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-060-host-code-initial.json
nodes.summary: Archived report of the first actual-host code review in the R-060 series, which the evaluation records as reporting three lifecycle defects, each reproduced by a failing regression and repaired; the evaluation also names six defects that were present but unreported in this first pass. Real Codex run with exact input digests and native receipts. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-060-host-code-prerequisites.json
nodes.summary: Archived report of the fifth actual-host code review in the R-060 series, which the evaluation records as finding that standalone dependents could reuse old tasks across an unresolved upstream planning gap; admission was changed to check prerequisites while still allowing independent queries. Real Codex run with exact input digests and native receipts. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-060-host-code-receipts.json
nodes.summary: Archived report of the sixth actual-host code review in the R-060 series, which the evaluation records as finding that failed reviews discarded available native attestation; the repair makes failure records privately retain exception receipts or returned execution results. Real Codex run with exact input digests and native receipts. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-060-resolution-plan.md
nodes.summary: The archived R-060 Reflection record and its implemented resolution plan: YAML front matter declares the title 'Profile 8 self Specs do not supply their registered Module interfaces', route specify, status implemented, the recording feature, branch, worktree and 27 touched files, and the body sets out the Problem (four reproduced target-level contract omissions), the Verification basis, a seven-step Change, the Validation runs to perform, and the risks and out-of-scope limits. A branch-local working record, not a Spec document of any registered Module.
nodes.languageNotes: The record is a Markdown file with YAML front matter carrying the machine-readable Reflection fields, so the same file serves as both queue entry and human plan.

nodes.name: R-060-spec-accepted.json
nodes.summary: Archived reports of the final repaired Spec reviews in the R-060 series, in which the same four representative task requests were accepted against the final runtime and Spec inputs on the four repaired target collections. Each case retains exact input digests and native Codex receipts, and the file disclaims any semantic-completeness claim. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-060-verification.json
nodes.summary: Archived verification identities and check results for the R-060 candidate change.599d4ebe… on branch design/domain-scopes-and-spec-contexts: the validation source digest, three configured candidate checks, the Python and docsite suite outcomes, generated agent surfaces, the final review records, the Reflection state and an explicit semantic_completeness field. Its declared workflow is existing direct-maintenance candidate validation with no delivery. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-071-dev-loop-diagnosis.md
nodes.summary: Archived read-only diagnosis of the R-071 dev-loop block, recorded before the later authorized manual integration. It establishes that the first blocker was a resume defect — a request carrying only a change_id was treated as an already-bound target, so `bind_owner()` raised `KeyError: 'target_id'` before routing or the development graph ran — corrects the previous assistant's causal ordering, separates routing from development phases and final validation, reports that the seven Modules' entity declarations match the registry while `.github/workflows/validate-source-checkout.yml` has no binding, proposes six minimal repairs with a required regression matrix, and states its evidence limits. A branch-local diagnostic record, not a Spec document of any registered Module.
nodes.languageNotes: Written mostly in Chinese with English headings and identifiers; source citations are relative repository links with line numbers, so the text is only readable against the baseline commit it pins.

nodes.name: R-071-invocations-and-probe.json
nodes.summary: Archived record of the capability invocations and probes behind the R-071 diagnosis, pinned to incident base commit 2c398af9…: historical dev-loop and main capability results, the independent review rejections where the returned task or constraints did not match the input, the read-only extracted-function probes that reproduced the failure in memory, and the stated probe limits. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-071-maintenance-integration.json
nodes.summary: Archived record of the explicitly user-authorized manual Git merge that integrated change.499465ba… from its source worktree into primary (source commit 22251f49…, merge commit 304dd2f9…, no conflicts), together with the inventory before cleanup, the source change state, the cleanup and verification steps and the removed tracked edits. It records `normal_delivery_completed: false` and `lifecycle_ready_claim: false`, so the merge is explicitly not a Framework delivery. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-071-prior-ci-verification.md
nodes.summary: Archived pre-merge CI maintenance verification report for the R-071 repair: it names the two changed files with their SHA256 values, describes the Ubuntu/uv/bubblewrap/Node environment, lists twelve successful checks (including 650 unittest cases, 27 Studio tests, 86 docsite tests and workflow YAML/bash syntax checks), states the boundaries not crossed (no push, remote CI run, deliver or lifecycle edit), and records the independent read-only review and the commit 22251f49 of only the two reviewed files. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-071-repair-review.json
nodes.summary: Archived record of two fresh independent read-only code reviews of the R-071 resume repair (change.beb86850…), each agent given its own complete registered Module contract and only the implementation that Module admits, neither inheriting the maintenance author's conversation or project-local Skills. It declares itself external maintenance review rather than a Framework review artifact and retains per-review limitations plus the reviewed file digests. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-071-repair-runs.json
nodes.summary: Archived test-run evidence for the R-071 resume repair at base commit 012db63f…: the failing baseline reproduction of `test_public_handoff_resumes_unbound_candidate_with_fresh_host` across all four specify/reviews combinations with `execution_failed: 'target_id'`, an intermediate full suite with three failures and three errors, focused regression runs, the final green 659-test suite, and the `build --check` and `validate` outputs, each with its command, exit code and output digest plus stated limitations. Not owned or bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: R-071-repair-verification.md
nodes.summary: Archived maintenance evidence for reflection R-071: it records the independent candidate branch and worktree, the behaviour/regression matrix over the four specify x run_reviews combinations that previously failed with execution_failed: 'target_id', a 659-test Python suite run, a clean validate and build --check, two fresh read-only complete-Module reviews with no blocking findings, and the F1-F3 follow-ups that remain open. Not bound or owned by any registered Module; it is a workspace record under .concorde/archive/.

nodes.name: R-072-review-rejection.json
nodes.summary: Single-line raw capture of a concorde-review stage completion for module.concorde that the host rejected with failure code invalid_completion ('blocking Spec finding requires its concrete gap'). It preserves the reviewer's two blocking findings, one advisory finding, two attributed gaps, the three passed gates and the launch/policy/workspace digests. Not bound or owned by any registered Module; it is archived reflection evidence.
nodes.languageNotes: The whole stage result is stored as one unformatted JSON line, so it is meant for machine comparison rather than reading.

nodes.name: agent-model-2569066-probes-after.json
nodes.summary: The 'after' probe output for the agent-model refactor, captured against commit 2569066 with substituted model subprocesses. It records nine Agent bindings each resolving to an agents/<name>/spec.md, the launch field list (now including agent_binding_json), narrowed role effects, read-only investigation and blocking AI-feedback observations, plus source SHA256 values and the verified commit. nodes.name: agent-model-2fc1992-plan.md
nodes.summary: Accepted maintenance plan resolving reflections R-066 to R-070 against baseline commit 2fc1992, with YAML front matter carrying the baseline test counts, layout and automatic-edge decisions and the per-phase P1-P5 progress and delivery log. The body verifies each root cause in the then-current source and proposes the agents/ package, a Harness type, binding the Agent definition into every invocation, a bounded local-loop policy and the development graph revision loop. nodes.name: agent-model-2fc1992-probes.json

nodes.name: agent-model-resolution.md

nodes.name: candidate-delivery-2026-09-09.md
nodes.summary: Delivery log for two host-created candidate worktrees completed and merged by direct maintenance on 2026-09-09. It records that neither candidate contained any work product, how the AGENTS.md guidance-block conflict was resolved, the design choices made where no Spec answered, the incidents during delivery, the Spec sentences replaced, and the per-change verification records. nodes.name: settings.json
nodes.summary: Claude Code settings for this source checkout: it allowlists routine build, read-only git and search commands, denies every worktree-creating form (EnterWorktree, worktree-isolated subagents, `git worktree add/move`, `claude --worktree`), and registers scripts/worktree-guard.py as both a PreToolUse and a WorktreeCreate hook. Observation: no registered Module owns or binds this file, so it is agent-runtime host configuration that sits outside the Spec model.
nodes.languageNotes: Deny entries mix tool names (EnterWorktree, Agent(isolation:worktree)) with Bash prefix patterns, so the declarative rules and the Python hook cover different attack shapes.

nodes.name: hooks.json
nodes.summary: Codex hook registration for the checkout: before every Bash or PowerShell tool call it runs scripts/worktree-guard.py, resolved through `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, so a developer session cannot create or relocate worktrees. Observation: not owned or bound by any registered Module; it is host configuration for the Codex agent runtime.

nodes.name: worktree.rules
nodes.summary: Codex prefix rules that forbid `git worktree add` and `git worktree move` in this checkout, with justifications stating that only the Concorde host creates worktrees, and only for a flow the developer explicitly asked for, because project-local Skills are worktree-owned build output. Its own comment notes that scripts/worktree-guard.py, registered in .codex/hooks.json, covers the forms a prefix rule cannot express. Not bound by any registered Module.
nodes.languageNotes: Starlark-style `prefix_rule(pattern=[...], decision=..., justification=...)` calls, matched against argv prefixes rather than against a shell string.

nodes.name: agent-model-2569066-probes-after.py
nodes.summary: Archived reflection evidence script that re-runs four design-review probes in temporary fixture projects to show reflections R-066 - R-070 resolved: a narrowed role declaration now raises SpecError(permission_denied) instead of widening writes, a read-only variant yields empty write_paths, every agent inventory entry resolves to a spec.md path plus harness binding and digest, and a blocking code-review finding is repaired once before the loop reaches `ready`; it finishes by recording source SHA-256 digests and the worktree HEAD. Observation: it imports `concorde.host.capability_host`, `agent_model`, `build` and `permissions` from a `src/concorde/host/` layout that no longer exists in the checkout, so it is historical evidence rather than runnable code, and no registered Module binds it.
nodes.languageNotes: Mutates sys.path to import the target worktree, substitutes model subprocesses with a ModelProcessDouble, and patches `capability_host.load_role_prompt` so no model service is ever called.

nodes.name: agent-model-2fc1992-probes.py
nodes.summary: The earlier archived probe script whose observations motivated reflections R-066 - R-069: it records the role and launch-specification field sets and how many roles bind a spec.md, shows that narrowing an implementation role's declared writes still left the effective write_paths widened, and drives a development loop whose blocking code review never triggers a repair iteration. Observation: it targets the retired `concorde.host.roles` / `src/concorde/host/` layout and is not bound by any registered Module.

nodes.name: module.md
nodes.summary: Spec Protocol chapter defining the Module kind: the required reading content (Purpose, Terminology, Usage, Design, Relationships), the rule that precise obligations (requirements, scenarios, canonical interfaces) live only in owned implementation-role units, composition and dependency declarations, realization bindings and external knowledge, completeness rules, and the module.md / module.md.json templates plus a scenario fragment. It is part of the tracked Protocol bundle the installer places under .concorde/protocol/; no registered Module owns it as a document unit or binds it as an implementation file.
nodes.languageNotes: Normative reference prose in RFC-style MUST/SHOULD/MAY, with fenced Markdown and JSON templates that are illustrative examples rather than live declarations.

nodes.name: .gitmodules

Not bound by any registered Module.
nodes.languageNotes: `concorde-sparse` is a non-standard key ignored by git itself; the project's own reference checkout script reads it to build each submodule's sparse-checkout rules.
